title: Healthcare Data Solutions Architect | FHIR
description:
**Can you imagine defining the clinical data architecture that enables seamless interoperability across a global healthcare ecosystem?**

Join our expert team to work on a healthcare digital platform, contributing to the development of standardized clinical data services and interoperability solutions. You will apply your knowledge of **HL7 FHIR**, **HL7 v2**, DICOM and healthcare data governance to define clinical data models, semantic standards and interoperability architectures. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure healthcare data is consistent, compliant and optimized for real-world clinical environments.

**How do we make this happen?**

With people. Besides your team and manager, you will have several support figures like a godparent, who will help you with the practical and administrative aspects of daily life during your first 6 months.

And the second most important person after you, your mentor, who will guide you through your entire onboarding and career at ERNI. You will have regular 1:1 meetings with them, and recurrently, you will work on your development plan to define your short-, medium-, and long-term goals.

At ERNI, we highly value experience and technical knowledge. As a senior profile, you will have the space to continue growing, whether by deepening your technical skills or having greater influence on project decisions, with autonomy and the opportunity to share knowledge with other experts.  
And if you are interested in mentoring, there is also space for that: supporting other ERNIans while still focusing on the technical excellence that sets us apart.

**What you will bring**  

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Healthcare Data Architecture, Clinical Informatics or Healthcare IT Interoperability.
* Expert knowledge of HL7 FHIR (R4/R5), HL7 v2.x messaging and healthcare interoperability standards.
* Strong experience with DICOM/DICOMweb, clinical terminologies and hospital information systems.
* Knowledge of healthcare data governance, semantic modeling, privacy regulations and data quality management.
* Fluent English and excellent communication skills to translate clinical workflows into technical specifications.

You will be responsible for defining clinical data models and interoperability architectures for healthcare platform services while establishing semantic governance and healthcare standards compliance. Translating hospital workflows into standardized specifications, integrating clinical terminologies, validating implementations and providing technical leadership across product, clinical and engineering teams.

**What if the project ends?**

We work on a wide variety of projects, technologies, and sectors, allowing you to keep growing in different environments. If a project ends or you feel ready for a new challenge, we will find another one that aligns with your professional development.

**Our working model ‍**

We ask you to be available for key meetings. Need to leave for a doctor’s appointment or to pick up your child from school? No problem. We trust you to deliver quality work within your 40-hour workweek.

Our model is hybrid: we usually go to the office 2 days a week, though this depends on the project and team, but we love seeing each other’s faces; the best stories always happen in the office!

You will also enjoy:

We cover your certifications and reward technical achievements up to €1,500.  
Private health insurance.  
Full coverage for sick leave  
‍️ Free emotional, legal, and family support.  
️‍️ Gym discounts or sports compensation.  
Flexible remuneration: meals, transport, childcare, etc.  
Referral bonuses: up to €6,000 per candidate and €5,000 per client.  
23 working days of vacation.  
️ Free language courses: English, Spanish, Catalan and German.

**And the salary?**

We will discuss it during the first call. If it is important to you, feel free to ask!

title: Senior Product Engineer / AI Solution Architect
description:
Senior Product Engineer / AI Solution ArchitectCountry: Spain

**IT STARTS HERE**

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Our **Chief Data & Artificial Intelligence Officer (CDAIO)** division is building a world-class AI & Data team to make a difference in the lives of over 170 million people worldwide, through one of the largest banks in the world.

We are undergoing one of the biggest transformations in our history and technology is at the heart of our strategy. Join our team to play a part in one of the most important technological projects for the financial sector in the world.

**THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE**

**The Santander Artificial Intelligence Team is seeking a Senior Product Engineer / AI Solution Architect,** based in our Madrid office, with global scope.

**You will support the design, development and evolution of AI-powered products and technical capabilities that accelerate integration, migration, modernization and application decommissioning across Santander Group. Reporting to the Global Head of AI Integration & Migration, you will act as a hands-on technical profile within a small product-oriented team, helping evolve internal assets such as Alchemy, integrate selected market solutions and translate product needs into scalable, secure and reusable technical components.**

This is a technical role with strong product orientation, requiring practical engineering capability, cloud and AI fluency, and the ability to work with vendors, DevOps, AI specialists, architects and country teams to turn opportunities into working solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

Support the technical evolution of AI-powered integration and migration products, including internal assets such as Alchemy and complementary market tools, translating roadmap needs, country requirements and product hypotheses into technical options, solution designs, epics, user stories and implementation increments.

Design and build reusable components, APIs, connectors, agentic workflows, evaluation scripts and automation assets that can scale across integration, migration, modernization and application decommissioning use cases.

Apply LLMs, agentic AI, RAG / GraphRAG patterns, code-analysis techniques and workflow automation to practical enterprise scenarios, working with AI Specialist and DevOps profiles to move prototypes toward robust, observable and maintainable capabilities.

Define technical guardrails, engineering practices and quality criteria for reusable AI-enabled tools, ensuring solutions align with Santander technology standards, AI governance principles, cybersecurity requirements and cloud architecture guidelines.

Evaluate vendor solutions, open-source tools and market capabilities, contributing to buy-vs-build assessments based on architectural fit, technical risk, integration complexity, cost drivers and time-to-value, and helping integrate selected capabilities into Santander environments.

Contribute to reference architectures, technical documentation, implementation playbooks and reusable patterns, while supporting issue resolution during PoCs, pilots and early adoption phases and feeding lessons learned back into the product roadmap.

Partner with Product Adoption & Value, Architecture, Cloud, vendors and country technology teams to assess technical feasibility, explain technical options and trade-offs, translate recurring needs into backlog inputs and support technical recommendations and decision materials.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Professional Experience**

* **6+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, cloud engineering, AI engineering or technical product development in enterprise environments.** (Required)
* **Hands-on experience building or evolving digital products** , platforms, automation tools, developer tools or integration capabilities. (Required)
* **Practical experience with AI-enabled systems** , LLM use cases, code analysis, workflow automation, RAG, agents or AI-assisted software engineering. (Required)
* **Experience working with APIs, enterprise integrations, cloud services, DevOps practices and secure software delivery** . (Required)
* Experience collaborating with product owners, vendors, architects and delivery teams in complex organizations. (Required)
* Experience in banking, financial services or another regulated technology environment. (Preferred)
* Exposure to technology modernization, application rationalization, legacy transformation or enterprise-platform migration initiatives. (Preferred)
* Experience supporting technical vendor assessments, PoCs or buy-vs-build decisions. (Preferred)

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Physics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. (Required)
* Relevant certifications in cloud, AI/ML, software engineering, architecture or cybersecurity. (Preferred)

**Languages**

* Full professional proficiency in English for global stakeholder engagement. (Required)
* Professional working proficiency in Spanish. (Preferred)
* Portuguese. (Preferred)

**Hard Skills**

* **Software engineering capability using Python or an equivalent language, APIs, Git, testing, documentation and maintainable code practices** . (Required)
* **AI/LLM engineering knowledge covering LLMs, agents, RAG / GraphRAG,** prompt and workflow design, evaluation and orchestration patterns. (Required)
* **Integration** technologies, including REST APIs, connectors, event-driven patterns, authentication and secure integration with enterprise systems. (Required)
* **DevOps fundamentals** , including CI/CD, containers, observability and infrastructure-as-code concepts. (Required)
* **Cloud** platform familiarity, particularly AWS; Azure experience is also valuable. (Preferred)
* Familiarity with MCP, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar agentic frameworks. (Preferred)
* Knowledge of knowledge graphs, code parsing, software-modernization tooling or static analysis. (Preferred)
* Security, privacy and regulatory awareness in AI-enabled enterprise solutions. (Preferred)

**Soft Skills**

* Strong product mindset, connecting technical choices with adoption, roadmap, value and scalability.
* Hands-on ownership and the ability to move from ambiguity to working technical increments.
* Clear communication, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-specialist stakeholders.
* Pragmatism, balancing speed, control, buy-vs-build decisions, innovation and governance.
* Strong collaboration skills in small multidisciplinary teams involving vendors, countries and internal platforms.

**WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT**

Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.

* We enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
* **Flexibility that works. Enjoy a hybrid working model -** some days remote, some days onsite with your team - along with flexible hours.
* **Learning for life.** Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com).
* **Competitive rewards.** Receive a highly competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, motivating you to keep growing with us.
* **Financial advantages.** Benefit from preferential banking terms, special interest rates on loans, life insurance, and more.
* Your health is our priority. Through BeHealthy, our global wellness programme, we promote holistic wellbeing.
* We know family is everything. That’s why we offer childcare support and family-friendly programmes tailored to each life stage.
* Always by your side. Get access to Santander Contigo, our program for employees and their families offering legal, emotional, and administrative advisory services.
* **Extra benefits.** Gym/WellHub membership, medical centers in some of our facilities, meal subsidy, parking, shuttle service from various points in Madrid, as well as exclusive discounts and offers for Santander employees. And that’s only the beginning - we’ll tell you more when you join!

We’re here **to keep you motivated** , help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.

**LOCAL COMPLIANCE**

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.

**WHAT TO DO NEXT**

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

En 2025, on a franchi un cap majeur en France : 300+ intégrations, le lancement de notre offre e-invoicing pour les éditeurs de logiciels, et la création d'une business unit dédiée — **Connectivity** — qui rassemble Engineering, Product et Partnerships sous un même toit.

En 2026, on passe la vitesse supérieure : 500+ apps sur notre marketplace, une équipe qui scale à 40 personnes, des revenus directement trackés par partenaire tech, et un écosystème qui devient un vrai moteur de croissance. On prépare aussi l'expansion internationale et l'ère de la connectivité IA, avec pour horizon **€40–50M ARR d'ici 2030**.

Pour y arriver, on recrute un(e) **Head of Tech Partnerships** : la personne qui va prendre la main sur notre stratégie partenaires, structurer l'équipe, lancer notre partner program, et transformer les intégrations en un vrai levier business.

**Comment tu vas contribuer ?**
-------------------------------

Tu rejoins la **business unit Connectivity**, en reporting direct au **General Manager Connectivity (Arnaud)**. Tu prends ownership de toute la fonction Tech Partnerships, avec deux membres d'équipe déjà en place (Partner Manager & Solution Engineer).

Concrètement, tu seras responsable de :

* Définir et exécuter la stratégie partenaires tech, alignée avec la vision Connectivity et Pennylane
* Structurer, recruter et faire grandir l'équipe en fonction de la roadmap
* Construire notre tech partner program (tiering, incentives, certifications, bénéfices associés)
* Transformer les partenariats tech en moteur de revenus et de génération de leads qualifiés (en lien avec Sales)
* Positionner Pennylane comme leader dans l'écosystème (événements partenaires, communauté, marketplace)
* Soutenir l'expansion internationale de notre réseau d'intégrations

**À quoi ressemblera ton quotidien ?**
--------------------------------------

* **Piloter la stratégie et le partner program** — Définir le tiering, les critères d'éligibilité, les bénéfices et les KPIs de succès (ARR généré, leads qualifiés, clients communs actifs)
* **Gérer le pipeline partenaires** — Qualifier les opportunités, prioriser les partenariats à fort potentiel, animer les relations avec les partenaires stratégiques (flux inbound et outbound)
* **Driver le partnership revenue** — Structurer les accords commerciaux, tracker les pipelines de leads générés par les partenaires, piloter la monétisation des intégrations
* **Scaler via l'IA et l'automatisation** — Réduire le time-to-release, déployer des outils self-onboarding (dev portal, partner portal) et embarquer l'IA dans les process quotidiens (support, documentation, automatisation)
* **Travailler en mode cross-fonctionnel** — Collaborer étroitement avec Product, Marketing et Sales pour maximiser l'impact des intégrations (enablement, GTM, adoption)
* **Builder et faire grandir l'équipe** — Manager les Partner Managers et Solution Engineers, recruter selon les besoins stratégiques
* **Owneriser les KPIs** — % de clients équipés, MRR attribué aux partenaires, leads qualifiés générés, taux de certification, usage actif par connecteur

**Le profil qu'on recherche**
-----------------------------

### **Must Have**

* **7+ ans d'expérience** en Business Development, Partnerships ou Alliances — idéalement dans une **scale-up B2B SaaS**
* Expérience dans les **alliances technologiques et intégrations API** (pas simplement des partenariats commerciaux) — tu sais ce qu'est un webhook, une API REST, un SDK
* **Track record avéré** dans la structuration d'un partner program (tiering, contracts, incentives)
* **Fort business acumen** : tu raisonnes en termes de ROI, pipeline et revenus générés
* **Leadership et gestion d'équipe** : tu as déjà managé des profils BD/Partnership et sais faire grandir une équipe
* Excellentes capacités de **négociation et de relationship-building** avec des interlocuteurs techniques ET business
* **Fluent French + professional English** (minimum)

### **Nice to Have**

* Connaissance de l'**écosystème comptable/financier français** (ERP, facturation, paie, etc.)
* Expérience dans le **management d'une marketplace ou app store**
* Expérience du **lancement à l'international** (Allemagne et/ou Espagne, un plus)
* Maîtrise d'outils comme **Salesforce, Crossbeam**, ou équivalent
* À l'aise avec l'**IA générative** dans son quotidien pro (Dust, Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator…)

### **Culture fit / Soft skills**

* Tu es **builder avant tout** — tu arrives dans un contexte encore en construction et ça t'excite
* Tu es à l'aise dans **l'ambiguïté** et tu sais prioriser sans qu'on te dise quoi faire
* Tu es **data-driven** sans être paralysé par le manque de données parfaites
* Tu as un sens aigu de **l'ownership** et tu t'engages sur des résultats, pas sur des activités
* Tu sais **influencer sans autorité** hiérarchique — la transversalité, c'est ton terrain de jeu

**Process de recrutement**
--------------------------

* **Screen TA** avec Alison — 30 min
* **WHO Interview** avec Arnaud (GM Connectivity) — 45 min
* **Cas pratique** + débrief avec Arnaud & Head of Sales SMEs (Jacob) ou Partners (Brieuc) — 1h
* **Last Round** — Global Head of Sales (Edouard) & Senior Engineering Manager Connectivity (Mathieu) — 30 min

title: Staff Engineer, KernelCare (worldwide remote, work anywhere)
description:
**TuxCare** offers a comprehensive portfolio of security solutions for Linux and open-source software designed for enterprise organizations. With TuxCare, companies can automate live vulnerability patching, minimize downtime, ensure security and compliance, and rely on a team with deep expertise in Linux security. The solutions cover the most popular Linux distributions, end-of-life systems, programming languages, and more.  
Learn more at: https://tuxcare.com/

**Product Description**

**KernelCare** provides automated live patching for Linux kernels without requiring reboots. Our Extended Lifecycle Support products keep end-of-life Linux distributions secure by backporting important security and bug fixes to older software versions used by enterprise customers.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Staff Engineer** to build the next generation of automation and high-reliability pipelines for KernelCare. In this role, you will evaluate and optimize existing engineering workflows, leveraging AI to eliminate bottlenecks and drive a 10x increase in operational throughput.

This role combines deep technical execution with technical product ownership. It is approximately 70% hands-on software engineering and 30% technical product ownership.

You will take ownership of significant product components and workstreams. This includes understanding what needs to be built, working directly with stakeholders, defining milestones and tasks, designing the solution, contributing production code, delivering it to customers, and continuing to own it in production.

This is an individual contributor role focused on technical ownership rather than people management. We are looking for someone who can operate independently, work effectively with unclear requirements, and proactively move large areas of work forward without waiting for a manager to define each next step.

The products and priorities may evolve over time. Therefore, curiosity, adaptability, and a general interest in cybersecurity are important for this role.

  
Responsibilities:

* Own major product components and workstreams throughout their full lifecycle, from initial discovery and planning to production release and ongoing improvement.
* Work directly with engineering, product, sales, and other stakeholders to understand, gather, and clarify business and technical requirements.
* Translate broad and sometimes unclear product goals into technical plans, milestones, and actionable engineering tasks.
* Design scalable system architecture and make technical decisions for high-impact product areas.
* Build, review, and maintain production-grade components end-to-end, ensuring reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and extensibility.
* Take responsibility for delivered components in production and their continued operation and evolution.
* Independently track progress and proactively communicate results, blockers, risks, dependencies, and changing requirements.
* Research relevant technologies, tools, market approaches, and competitor solutions when needed.
* Contribute to engineering quality through design reviews, technical guidance, mentorship, and best practices.

  
**Requirements**  

* Proven experience owning major projects or workstreams end-to-end.
* Strong backend engineering experience in Python.
* Comfortable reading and reviewing C language code.
* Strong hands-on Linux background.
* Strong system design and architectural thinking, combined with the ability to implement proposed solutions hands-on.
* Experience gathering and refining requirements and turning broad or unclear needs into technical plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Strong technical product ownership and an understanding of how engineering decisions support broader product and business goals.
* Ability to work independently without close day-to-day supervision.
* Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with engineering teams, product stakeholders, sales, and other departments.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, and blockers.
* Regular use of AI-assisted development tools for planning, implementation, debugging, testing, refactoring, or code review. AI should be part of the development workflow rather than used only for occasional experimentation.
* Ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term scalability, maintainability, and extensibility.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with writing patches for the Linux kernel or writing your own kernel modules
* Proficiency in C programming and debugging skills
* Deep understanding of how operating systems work

  
**Benefits**

**What's in it for you?**

* A focus on professional development.
* Interesting and challenging projects.
* Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
* Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
* Compensation for private medical insurance.
* Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
* Budget for education.
* The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

*By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (**https://cloudlinux.com/legal/privacy-policies-hub/* *), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.*

title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
Job Description

**Electrical Design Engineer**

**Silent Aire - Dublin**

**Who We Are**

Silent Aire, part of Johnson Controls, is a global leader in designing and manufacturing mission-critical custom air handlers, liquid cooling systems, and modular data centres for hyperscale cloud and colocation providers. We deliver high-performance solutions that prioritise quality, scalability, innovation, and rapid deployment.

**What You Will Do**

As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be involved within the electrical design and development of innovative large-scale liquid cooling solutions, CDU projects, and mission-critical HVAC equipment.

You will collaborate with engineering managers, mechanical engineering teams, controls specialists, manufacturing, and project stakeholders to deliver safe, efficient, and compliant electrical designs that meet customer requirements and industry standards.

You will take ownership of electrical system design activities, from concept development and detailed engineering through manufacturing support and final project documentation. Working closely with our Electrical Panel Manufacturing team, you will develop bespoke electrical panel designs, power distribution systems, and control architectures that support high-performance mission-critical facilities.

Your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects, ensuring technical excellence, reliability, and scalability throughout the project lifecycle.

**How You Will Do It**

* Analyse and interpret customer specifications, technical requirements, and project drawings, ensuring compliance with applicable electrical codes and standards.

* Develop detailed electrical designs, power distribution schematics, and single-line diagrams using CAD and electrical design software.

* Produce controls schematics, wiring diagrams, and electrical/control panel layouts for custom air handling and cooling equipment.

* Perform electrical engineering calculations including load analysis, fault current calculations, cable sizing, MCA, overcurrent protection, and voltage drop assessments.

* Design and specify electrical power and control systems, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation.

* Select, evaluate, and specify electrical components and equipment, preparing accurate bills of materials and technical documentation.

* Review and approve design deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.

* Prepare comprehensive project submittal packages including drawings, calculations, data sheets, specifications, and supporting documentation.

* Collaborate with mechanical, controls, manufacturing, and project management teams to ensure seamless multidisciplinary integration.

* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers and designers.

* Support manufacturing, commissioning, field service, procurement, and customer teams with technical expertise throughout project execution.

* Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Support business development and bid activities through technical input, design reviews, and cost estimation.

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (BEng, BSc Eng) or equivalent qualification.

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical. ePLAN experience would be beneficial.

* 5+ years' experience in electrical design engineering, preferably within HVAC, data centre, industrial, critical infrastructure, or related industries.

* Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution systems, motor controls, panel design, and control system integration.

* Extensive knowledge of relevant electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices.

* Experience performing electrical calculations and developing engineering design documentation.

* Strong understanding of electrical protection, control systems, and power system design principles.

* Ability to review and interpret complex technical specifications and customer requirements.

* Strong project planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineering team members.

* Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to continuous improvement and technical development.

description:
Location: Dublin 2

Date: Aug 11, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1726141

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**FS Technology Consulting – Senior Solution Architect - Senior Manager/Director – Dublin**

  

**General Information**

**Location:** Dublin

**Available for VISA Sponsorship:** Yes

**Business Area:** Technology Strategy Transformation

**Contract Type:** Full Time - Permanent

  

EY is in a great place today. We’re helping more clients, in more places, tackle more of their toughest challenges than ever before. The exceptional career experience you’ll have at EY will be unlike any other because of our exceptional and diverse people. We empower our people by offering the culture, the tech, the teams, the scale, the challenges, the learning, and the relationships for you to personalize and build your career.

In EY FSO Technology Consulting, we are expanding our team of solution architects, who will be a key driver of our strategy for future growth. EY’s global strategy and ambition is to deliver long-term value to clients, people, and society. It is inspired by the way innovations spread through society.

  

At EY FSO Technology Consulting, you'll collaborate with top-tier professionals to tackle the most intricate challenges in the financial services sector in Ireland. Our mission is to shape a progressive future for financial services in Ireland, and your expertise is the key. Our projects are multifaceted, often involving complex stakeholder management and a wide range of technologies and applications. Your role is pivotal—providing insightful advice drawn from your knowledge and experience to steer our clients towards optimal outcomes.

As a member of our Technology Consulting Team, you'll be part of dynamic group known for their exceptional performance and dedication to client service. You'll have the opportunity to empower organizations to expand, innovate, and enhance their operational efficiency. Your contribution will be instrumental in our collective goal of creating a better working world.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

Join our forward-thinking team of solution architects and play a pivotal role in driving technological innovation within the financial sector. As a member of our team, you will:

* Craft Strategic Architectural Visions: Develop and refine the overarching technology architecture strategy to support our client’s financial services' business goals and digital transformation initiatives.
* Design Cutting-Edge Solutions: Architect scalable, secure, and resilient solutions that address complex business challenges and deliver value to our clients.
* Facilitate Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with business leaders, IT experts, and third-party vendors to ensure a shared understanding and alignment of technology solutions with business objectives.
* Lead Technology Selection: Assess emerging technologies and recommend solutions that enhance our service offerings and operational efficiency.
* Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Guarantee that all architectural designs adhere to financial regulations, security standards, and data protection laws.
* Support Project Execution: Provide technical leadership across projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, and quality outcomes.
* Manage Risks Proactively: Identify and mitigate potential risks within the technology landscape to maintain system integrity and reliability.
* Drive Performance Improvements: Analyse current systems and processes to recommend enhancements that optimize performance and user experience.
* Mentor and Develop Talent: Lead and nurture a team of architects and engineers, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous learning.
* Champion Innovation: Stay at the forefront of FinTech advancements to integrate innovative solutions that keep us ahead in a competitive market.

  

If you are a visionary leader with a passion for technology and a deep understanding of the financial services industry, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity to make a significant impact.

  

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* A bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in solution architecture, preferably within the financial services industry, demonstrating a track record of successful project delivery.
* Proficiency in modern technologies and architectural patterns.
* Familiarity with cloud services, cybersecurity, and infrastructure
* A deep understanding of financial services operations, regulatory requirements, and emerging FinTech trends.
* Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and provide innovative solutions.
* A strategic mindset to align technology solutions with business goals and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience of working with the Agile methodology.

  

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Relevant professional certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, etc.) may be preferred or required.
* Familiarity with Agile, DevOps practices, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to improve the speed and quality of software development.
* Experience working in or with international teams, understanding of global markets, and the ability to navigate cultural differences.
* Experience in negotiating with and managing third-party vendors and service providers.
* Ability to work across various domains and systems, and willingness to learn new technologies as needed.

  

**What we look for**

* Someone who is passionate about reaching their full potential and excelling in their career
* Someone with energy, enthusiasm and courage who enjoys solving complex problems and variety in their day-to-day working life
* Someone who enjoys working as part of a community which values integrity, respect, teaming, and inclusiveness

  

**What working at EY offers**

We offer a competitive remuneration package. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Mercury is the European leader in construction solutions.

We build and manage complex engineering & construction projects for the world’s leading corporations. Our solutions help deliver technologies and life changing advancements that connect people, communities, and businesses, giving them the power to achieve incredible things. Our people have the courage to be innovative. Their determination and sharp focus enable us to deliver with certainty, time and time again.

We deliver our clients’ visions through leading edge construction solutions across multiple sectors, including Enterprise Data Centres, Advanced Technology & Life Sciences, Hyperscale Data Centres, Fire Protection.

At Mercury, it is our duty to encourage and back our people to realise their vision of themselves. We place them at the heart of what we do, providing challenging opportunities to develop within a great team in a supportive environment that allows them to reach their full potential.

  

**Key Responsibilities of the Role:**

  

**Team Management:**

* Collaborate with engineers, and construction managers to develop comprehensive project plans and ensure delivery on schedule.
* Collaborate with any other consultants, subcontractors, supervisors, planners, estimators, quantity surveyors and the general workforce involved in the project.
* Liaise with clients and other 3rd parties as required, such as insurance companies, vendors, etc.
* Develop comprehensive scope-of-works (SoW), task information deliverables lists (TIDP), and responsibility matrices (R&R/ RACI) for Mechanical disciplines.
* Raise any design-related risks to planning, commercial and management, and establish a course to minimise their impact.
* Maintain accurate records of key design activities (e.g. changes, issues) as they arise and escalate to management as appropriate.
* Assist the Central Engineering and site teams with proactive contributions to construction and team matters.
* Attend design related meetings and provide continual input for optimisation.
* Collaborate on new design issues/ changes/ research within the team.
* Assist with new tenders and PCSA (pre-construction services agreements) deliverables within the Business Unit.

  

**Project Management & Planning:**

* Oversee the construction process to ensure adherence to design specifications and schedules.
* Assist in developing design delivery schedules along with the client, project manager, design team and consultants.
* Manage the deliverables and approvals processes of design packages to ensure full approval for procurement.
* Check design programmes on projects are aligned to consultant resource and construction/ procurement requirements.
* Conduct site visits and report progress and quality of work.
* Correctly follow information control and flow standards e.g. for RFIs, use of ACC, etc.

  

**Technical Engineering:**

* Ensure Mechanical technical compliance on all projects.
* Ensure knowledge of client and country-specific design standards.
* Assess and mitigate potential risks and issues as they’re identified in design, or that could have potential impact on construction activities.
* Review design proposals by others for suitability and constructability.
* Offer proposals for added value (VE) and off-site manufacturing (OSM).
* Ensure material choices are aligned to project requirements, budget, and QEHS standards.
* Prepare comprehensive handover packs to the site team for any packages under your responsibility.
* Coordinate and manage coordination of Mechanical disciplines and interfaces with CSA and Electrical.
* Check plans, drawings, and quantities for accuracy of calculations.
* Manage, monitor, and interpret the contract design documents supplied by the client or architect.

  

**Sustainability:**

* Integrate sustainable practices into design and construction processes.
* Evaluate the environmental impact of projects and propose options for improvements.

  

**Documentation:**

* Prepare detailed reports, and documentation for project approval and permits.
* Maintain accurate records of project progress and changes.
* Manage key registers throughout the project design period:
    
  + Procurement schedule.
  + TIDP/ MIDP.
  + RFI log.
  + Deviation tracker.
  + Lessons Learnt log.
  + Issues, interface & scope gap trackers.
  + Design change tracker.
  + Value Engineering Register
  + OSM Register

  

**Other:**

* Provide technical guidance and support to construction teams.
* Review and submit technical submittals.
* Assist with recruitment activities for the Central Engineering team as deemed suitable.
* Undertake other engineering tasks or duties as required by the Engineering Manager and/ or Company.

  

The Company reserves the right to vary the scope and nature of the Employee’s normal duties to consider changes in the Company’s work patterns and practices and the requirements of its business

  

**Essential Criteria for the Role:**

* Minimum 7 years post graduate experience in the Industrial, Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences or Data Centre sectors.
* Demonstration of design, technical and construction knowledge is essential for this role.
* Experience in leading meetings and coordinating the other team members.
* Strong working knowledge of design and analysis software such as BIM, Revit.
* Clean driving licence essential

  

***Mercury is an equal opportunities employer*****.**

title: FDE Teaching Expert (Part-time)
description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer *why* their approach is wrong.

**Your audience:** Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

**Format:** Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

**Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.**

  
Requirements:
  

* 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
* Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
* Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
* Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
* Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
* Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
* Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

**Preferred experience:**

* Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
* Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
* Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
* Work experience at a recognizable company.
* Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

  
Brand:
  
TripleTen  
  
What you will do:
  

* Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
* Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
* Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
* Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

  
What we can offer you:
  

* Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
* A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
* Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
* A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

title: Senior Product Engineer - Supply Team
description:
Hi! I’m Fedir, Engineering Manager for Team Supply at WeTravel

Our team’s mission is to turn WeTravel from a product into a network. Today a travel operator can run their own business on WeTravel. Next, we want them to plug into each other, co-selling trips, sharing itineraries, and settling commissions automatically, without a single spreadsheet or bank transfer in between. If you want to build the operating system an entire industry runs on, and to be in the room when we decide what that system should be, let’s build something we’re proud of, together!

**About WeTravel**
------------------

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we’re on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we’re building the engine to make more of that possible.

**What’s the role**
-------------------

Almost no travel operator works alone. Agents, B2C tour operators and destination management companies buy from suppliers, resell each other’s trips, and split the money afterwards. Today that all happens in spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and PDF quotes; Which is why pricing a trip takes days, and why nobody can tell you two years later how a number was calculated.

Team Supply is building the layer that replaces it. We’re five engineers, and a PM, working on the earliest part of WeTravel’s roadmap: first the single-player OS, how an operator designs a trip, prices it, and sells it, then the multiplayer layer that connects operators to their suppliers and to each other. Getting this right makes WeTravel the tool operators open every morning, and roughly doubles the market we can serve.

You’ll join us to build that foundation and take it from early access to something thousands of operators depend on. What’s on our plate:

* Quoting: a pricing engine in our new service: multiple currencies, tax regimes, margins, seasonal rates.
* Supplier & Product Catalog: a place where operators keep their suppliers, negotiated rates and reusable trip building blocks.
* The Partner Network: supplier onboarding, verification and payouts, so money moves between operators and their suppliers automatically.
* Next up, the explicitly multiplayer pieces: supplier arrangements, commission flows, and a booking marketplace.

It is, in effect, a startup inside a company that already has customers, revenue and scale, much closer to 0 1 than most senior roles you’ll look at this year.

**What you’ll do day-to-day**
-----------------------------

* Lead and build features end-to-end: from reviewing user interviews and product design, through architecture and building systems, to deployment and monitoring in production.
* Partner closely with our product team to discover user problems and shape their solutions, you’ll help decide what is worth building, not only how to build it.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code across both frontend (TypeScript/React) and backend (Ruby on Rails).
* Ensure our services are always on by building resilient applications, making sure they are well monitored, and mitigating incidents as an on-call/incident responder.
* Mentor teammates and contribute to WeTravel’s engineering practices and excellence.

**How we work**
---------------

* We’re focused on the impact. We don’t subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what’s impactful.
* We’re a distributed team: some of us in Amsterdam, the rest remote across Europe.
* We’re using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.
* Stack: We’re using React/ReactNative/TypeScript + Ruby on Rails and Python Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we’re working with the major LLM providers.

**You should apply if you have**
--------------------------------

**Basic qualifications**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience (ideally full-stack) with strong product ownership mindset
* Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, this one is a must. You’ve owned whole apps or large areas of a frontend, and you want to keep doing that.
* Solid backend experience in any recognized modern language: Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, .NET, Node/TypeScript, Ruby. Depth and engineering judgment matter to us more than the specific language.
* Built and launched something new in a startup or scale-up, and stayed with it as it grew (0 1 100)
* Breadth over narrow specialization: you’ve worked across the stack and across different kinds of problems, and you move to where the work is
* Experience building applications working with distributed systems, microservices and event-driven architecture, with strong systems thinking and an eye for scalability
* Experience operating applications in production: monitoring, alerting and on-call
* Excellent communication skills and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams
* Experience leading projects and mentoring other engineers
* Experience using AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Code, Codex etc

**Preferred qualifications**

* Ruby on Rails. It’s our backend stack, so it’s a plus, but we hire for general engineering strength and expect a strong engineer to pick it up.
* Experience in an adjacent domain: marketplaces, supplier or vendor networks, payments and fintech, travel-tech, B2B2C platforms, or quoting / booking / costing systems. A plus, never a requirement.
* Comfortable running your own infrastructure (AWS / Kubernetes)
* Building and maintaining component libraries and working with a design system; micro front-ends; React Native
* Recent experience in building AI-enabled or Agentic applications
* Direct experience with customer interviews and user research

**You might not be the right fit if you**
-----------------------------------------

* Prefer to work in isolation rather than working closely with product teams
* Are uncomfortable with end-to-end responsibility from conception to production monitoring
* Would rather receive well-specified tickets than help decide what to build
* Don’t enjoy learning new technologies or adapting to different tech stacks
* Are not interested in understanding user problems and business context
* Prefer purely technical roles without product ownership responsibilities
* Are uncomfortable with the ambiguity that comes with building new products in a growing team

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Make a real impact: you’ll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.
* Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.
* Be part of building the best engineering team: you’ll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.
* Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, remote-friendly work culture, and annual company offsites (our last one was in Italy ).

**Benefits**
------------

* Attractive compensation.
* Full-time - Fixed Term Contract (as International Contractor).
* Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.
* Amsterdam Program – visit us in Amsterdam (HQ) for 2-4 weeks every year, staying in one of our WeTravel apartments.
* Although this is a remote role, employees are hired into a designated country of employment. Our Work From Anywhere perk provides eligible employees with up to four weeks per calendar year to work temporarily from another approved location.
* Extensive paid family leave.
* Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.
* 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.
* Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success. Coverage for certain work-from-home (WFH) equipment.
* Cambly for colleagues for whom English is not their first language.
* Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

**Please note:**

* As a member of our international team, you’ll work full-time under a B2B contractor agreement, with monthly payments in USD.

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
We're looking for a senior technical consultant who thrives across the full arc of a complex technical engagement, from pre-sales scoping and architecture through hands-on delivery and handoff. As the sole Technical Services presence in EMEA, you'll work with our most strategic enterprise customers to design and implement custom solutions on the Asana platform, partnering closely with Account Executives, Solutions Consultants, and Customer Success Managers to move deals forward and deliver with excellence. You'll write code, shape architecture, and engage directly with IT and business leaders, bringing the same rigor, standards, and craft that define Technical Services globally to every engagement you run in the region.

In the pre-sales motion, you'll partner with AEs and SEs to assess technical feasibility, define scope, and shape deal strategy for complex enterprise opportunities. In the post-sales motion, you'll own delivery end-to-end, designing and building scalable solutions using the Asana platform and third-party APIs, advising customer engineering teams on integration architecture, and helping customers unlock new value through AI-powered workflows, data migrations, and custom automation. You'll work alongside Implementation Managers to coordinate delivery, align on project milestones, and ensure a seamless customer experience from kickoff through close. You'll operate as a high-trust extension of the global Technical Services team, bringing a sharp customer-centric perspective from EMEA back to the central practice and contributing to how we evolve GTM offerings, delivery frameworks, tooling, and the Asana developer platform. A core part of this role is establishing consistent, globally-aligned ways of working across EMEA, applying the same playbooks, delivery standards, and engagement practices that define Technical Services everywhere.

This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

  

**What you'll achieve**

* Partner with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers during the pre-sales cycle — scoping custom engagements, assessing technical feasibility, and contributing to deal strategy for complex enterprise opportunities
* Own the technical strategy for each engagement — from initial scoping and architecture through delivery and handoff
* Design and deliver scalable, customized solutions — including AI-augmented workflows — that integrate Asana into complex enterprise ecosystems
* Lead post-sales delivery from kickoff through close — owning the project lifecycle, writing and reviewing code, and partnering with Customer Success Managers to ensure customers realize lasting value
* Partner with Implementation Managers to coordinate project delivery, maintain momentum, and hold a high bar for customer experience throughout each engagement
* Drive regional alignment with global Technical Services standards — raising the bar on delivery quality and ensuring every engagement reflects the practices and expectations that define the global team
* Evaluate technical feasibility of sophisticated customer use cases and drive alignment on solution strategy across cross-functional teams
* Engage with the EMEA services partner ecosystem — contributing to partner selection based on competency and fit, and serving as a technical stakeholder on partner-led engagements to ensure consistency with global delivery standards
* Identify patterns across engagements to build repeatable frameworks, tools, and delivery assets
* Serve as a senior voice of the customer with Product and Engineering — translating field insights and your own developer experience into roadmap influence

  

**About you**

* 8+ years in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Customer Engineer), with a track record of owning complex enterprise engagements end-to-end
* 5+ years of hands-on programming (Python or Node.js required), with deep fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture
* Experience spanning pre-sales and post-sales technical roles — you're as comfortable scoping and pricing a complex engagement alongside an AE as you are heads-down in delivery with a customer engineering team
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools — including LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic workflows — to accelerate development, enhance solution design, and deliver smarter outcomes for customers
* Systems thinker — you architect for scale, anticipate failure modes, and build with both today's constraints and tomorrow's needs in mind
* Technically curious and current — you stay ahead of the curve on AI/ML tooling, developer platform trends, and emerging automation patterns, and actively bring that knowledge back to the team
* Executive-ready communicator — equally at home in a code editor and a boardroom, with the ability to translate complexity into clarity for any audience
* Owner-operator mindset — you don't just deliver; you build the systems, playbooks, and team habits that make delivery repeatable at scale
* Proven ability to operate as a solo regional practitioner within a global team — self-directed and independent day-to-day, while staying tightly aligned to centralized standards, ways of working, and team expectations
* Build strong working relationships across customer and internal stakeholders throughout each engagement, and influence with clarity and empathy
* Familiarity with services partner ecosystems — you know how to assess partner competencies, contribute to selection decisions, and show up as an effective technical stakeholder on engagements where partners are leading delivery

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Computer/Data Science Staff Engineer for CAD - Cork, Ireland
description:
**Company:**
------------

QT Technologies Ireland Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

**General Summary:**

**About the role**

Qualcomm Technologies Inc. Global CAD team develops advanced tools, flows, methodologies, and software platforms that enable next-generation VLSI design across Qualcomm's product portfolio. This position requires deep expertise in computer science, combinatorial optimization, and scalable software architecture, combined with the ability to drive technical strategy across complex engineering domains.

You will lead the development of CAD technologies, design methodologies, and automation solutions that enable implementation flows for advanced semiconductor technologies (3nm and below). Working within a highly interdisciplinary environment spanning hardware, software, and algorithmic research, you will help define and drive innovative solutions to large-scale microelectronic design challenges through data-driven decision making and advanced optimization techniques.

Innovation is a core aspect of this role. Operating at the intersection of electronic design automation (EDA), artificial intelligence, data analytics, and software engineering, you will identify emerging opportunities, influence technical direction, and translate research concepts into production-quality solutions. We seek candidates with strong expertise in constraint reasoning, mathematical optimization, and algorithm design, coupled with demonstrated experience in building scalable software systems, driving engineering best practices, and collaborating across geographically distributed teams.

As a technical leader, you will architect and implement advanced automated reasoning frameworks to solve highly complex VLSI design challenges using techniques from artificial intelligence, constraint programming, SAT solving, mathematical optimization, integer programming, and metaheuristics. You will also provide technical mentorship, guide architectural decisions, influence roadmaps across teams, and drive the adoption of innovative methodologies that improve productivity, quality, and scalability across Qualcomm's design ecosystem.

**Experience & Education we would love to see:**

* Recognized technical expertise in automated reasoning, AI optimization, constraint solving, operations research, or related computational methods, with a demonstrated track record of advancing state-of-the-art solutions in complex problem domains.
* Deep expertise in graph theory, combinatorial optimization, advanced data structures, and algorithmic design, with the ability to apply these concepts at scale to solve highly complex engineering challenges.
* Proven ability to architect, innovate, and drive the development of next-generation constraint reasoning and optimization frameworks, delivering significant improvements in scalability, performance, and solution quality.
* Demonstrated leadership in designing and delivering high-performance, production-grade software systems, establishing engineering best practices across software architecture, testing, code quality, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and long-term maintainability.
* Expert-level programming skills in Python, with the ability to define technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive adoption of modern software engineering practices.

title: Customer Solutions Architect, Manager
description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

**About Us**

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

**About the role**

Fivetran + dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We're looking for a Manager to lead and grow our Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) function within the Field Engineering team in EMEA, driving expansion and retention across our Commercial and Enterprise books. You will manage a team of CSAs responsible for the post-onboarding strategic technical ownership of Fivetran + dbt Lab's most important customers from initial engagement through ongoing adoption, workload expansion, and long-term revenue growth.

This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, commercial impact and strategic excellence. You will ensure customers realise expanding value from Fivetran + dbt Labs through structured workload-based engagement, foster and evangelise a culture of proactive, data-driven customer ownership across the Revenue Org, and lead initiatives alongside senior stakeholders that continue to mature the CSA function both in-region and globally.

This is a full-time position based remotely out of Ireland. Whilst all Solution Architect positions are remote, we encourage being in the office where possible. Furthermore, our SAs also do their best to be onsite with customers in-person; travel therefore is optional but encouraged.

This position will report into the EMEA Director of Customer Solutions Architecture, working alongside a leadership team that encompasses a Principal CSA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As a CSA Manager, you will:

* Lead a team of Senior and Lead Customer Solutions Architects across NEMEA, DACH, and France/Benelux, ensuring high-quality post-sales technical ownership across Fivetran + dbt Lab's Enterprise portfolio.
* Own accountability for the expansion and retention outcomes across the assigned book, measured on Incremental ARR (iARR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), ensuring book coverage, engagement depth, and measurable outcomes across regions and verticals.
* Develop and mature the CSA function, formalising methodology, reinforcing operational discipline, and evolving the ways the team operates to scale across the Enterprise segment.
* Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering leadership (RVPs, SE Managers, and their teams) to align the CSA motion with regional GTM priorities, ensuring the Pod (AE / SA / CSA) operates as a single account team rather than three parallel functions.
* Oversee half-yearly portfolio planning, including CSA to AE pairings, tier assignments, vertical ownership, and coverage across regional and specialist territories.
* Enable team development and growth, providing 1x1 coaching, managing career development plans (CDPs) against the CSA competency framework, and creating an environment where senior, tenured technical ICs continue to grow.
* Cultivate the operational and AI-driven stack that sits at the foundation of the CSA role, that gives the team a proactive, data-first view of the book and ensure the team continues to treat it as a differentiator.
* Work with partners and other GTM stakeholders to unlock cross-portfolio expansion, particularly with Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and adjacent technology partners.
* Have a signal-based mindset for identifying attrition and churn risks, using the platform and holistic data available to you to build plans alongside customer stakeholders for protecting accounts and thus protecting revenue.

**What We're Looking For (Skills & Experience)**
------------------------------------------------

* Leadership experience in post-sales technical roles (Customer Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, Delivery Solutions Architecture, or equivalent), ideally within SaaS, cloud, or data integration environments.
* Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to tie post-sales technical engagement directly to measurable business outcomes (iARR, NRR, GRR).
* Technical familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery), data integration technologies, and modern data stack tooling (including dbt).
* Experience managing senior, tenured technical ICs, with the ability to add value beyond individual technical depth by leading through coaching, calibration, and cross-functional advocacy.
* Stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing senior cross-functional peers (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Partners) and senior customer stakeholders alike.
* Data-native management style, comfortable using data and AI tooling in your own practice: pulling your own numbers, using LLMs and agent-based tools to inform decisions, and treating operational tooling as an input to your judgement.
* Cross-regional adaptability, comfortable working effectively across different sales cultures, languages and customer profiles within EMEA.
* Analytical mindset, with comfort in leveraging metrics to drive accountability and decision-making.
* Adaptability and growth orientation, thriving in dynamic environments and helping scale functions globally.

### **Nice to Have**

* Knowledge or practical use of Fivetran and/or dbt. If not those tools specifically, then industry equivalents (data integration platforms such as Airbyte, Matillion, Stitch, Talend, Informatica; transformation tooling such as Coalesce, SQLMesh, or similar).

**Perks and Benefits**

* 100% employer-paid medical insurance**\***
* Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
* RSU stock grants\*
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

* *May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information*

*Click* *here* *to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*

We're honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.
