The team owns the full stack - from the React/TypeScript frontend built on our shared WARP design system (warp-ds.github.io/docs/), to the Kotlin backend powered by CQRS event sourcing and domain-driven design. We are in the process of expanding CSX into the central hub for all back-office UI and workflows across the organization, which means there is significant room to shape both the product and the technical direction.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role in a team that values pragmatism, ownership, and shipping over process. You will collaborate closely with your Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer, and Engineering peers, with a short feedback loop from ideation to production.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  
Design, build, and maintain user-facing features in the CSX domain - Including our React/TypeScript frontend as well as any other user interface solutions we deliver
  
Ensuring a polished and efficient experience for our internal users
  
Contribute to the Kotlin backend - building APIs, integrating with downstream services, and evolving our event-sourced architecture
  
**Take ownership of features end-to-end:** from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
  
Collaborate with Product and Design to translate user needs into well-crafted solutions, using the WARP design system (warp-ds.github.io/docs/) as the foundation
  
Improve developer experience, tooling, and code quality within the team
  
Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for the services we own
  
Contribute to the team’s strategic evolution as CSX grows its scope to cover more backoffice domains (moderation tools, claims handling, compliance workflows)
  
  
Relevant Qualifications & Experiences
  
  
**Solid experience with modern frontend development:** React, TypeScript, and component-based architectures
  
Experience with backend development or willingness to learn
  
Comfortable working across the full stack - you do not need to be an expert in everything, but you are curious and willing to go where the problem is
  
**Familiarity with modern development practices:** CI/CD, automated testing, code review, trunk-based development
  
Experience building internal tools or back-office applications
  
Experience with design systems
  
  
Personal Attributes
  
  
Self-driven and comfortable with autonomy - you thrive in a small team where you own your work and make decisions
  
Pragmatic problem solver who favors shipping over perfection, while maintaining quality where it matters
  
Collaborative and communicative - you share context, ask for help, and give constructive feedback
  
Curious about the domain and the users - you want to understand the “why” behind what you build
  
Comfortable with ambiguity and change - CSX is evolving, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk
  
Solution-oriented mindset - you think in terms of user outcomes, not specific technologies. While the current stack is React/TypeScript, you recognize that the best interface for a workflow might be a traditional UI, an AI agent, a CLI tool, or something entirely new
  
Forward-leaning and eager to adopt new technologies - We always strive to raise the bar of what small teams can deliver and to solve our problems in the most efficient way possible.
  
  
GOT YOUR ATTENTION?Apply now! We will review applications continuously as they come in. The deadline for this role is 30th August 2026
  
  
**A few words from Engineering Manager, Alexander Thorén:**  
"CSX is a highly specialized and fast-moving team, leveraging the bleeding edge of technology to deliver efficient workflows for our customer-service agents and internal users. Since our user base consists of our direct colleagues, we are able to stay highly innovative in how we deliver solutions. We have full control of our product and enjoy the trust from our users to ensure their work is as fast and efficient as possible. It's quite an exhilarating experience going from an idea to a full-fledged product feature within a day!"
  
  
QUESTIONS?Alexander Thorén, Senior Engineering Manager, is happy to tell you more about the daily work and answer any questions you may have via LinkedIn / alexander.thoren@vend.com
  
  
**At Vend, our mission is simple:** Smart choices made easy.
  
  
We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.
  
  
Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.
  
  
At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
**Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.**

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

**Part of something bigger**  
Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.  
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.  
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, Spain,Portugal

**Your hiring experience matters**  
Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.  
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

**The Infrastructure & IT unit at Shine**
-----------------------------------------

Our Infrastructure & IT unit builds and operates the cloud platforms, developer tooling, and IT services that underpin every product Shine ships. We run multiple cloud teams (AWS, GCP, Azure), Engineering Efficiency, and IT operations. Infrastructure security is a dedicated function within this unit — senior engineers who own the security posture of our cloud estate as a traversal role across all teams.

**Your role as a Staff Platform Engineer (Infrastructure Security)**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

We're looking for a **Staff Platform Engineer** to own the security of our Azure cloud environment and contribute to multi-cloud security strategy. Azure is a strategic platform for the group, driven by recent acquisitions, and it needs the same security depth we are already building on AWS.

This is a hands-on, senior IC role. You will define security architecture, build controls as code, harden identity, implement detection, and partner with platform teams to make secure defaults the path of least resistance. You work alongside a peer Staff Platform Engineer who covers AWS and IT, sharing cross-cloud strategy while owning separate execution domains.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Define and implement the **security architecture** for our Azure estate — policy guardrails, network security, encryption, identity hardening, and secure defaults.
* Own the **security of our Azure landing zone** — the platform teams build it, you ensure it's built securely and that workloads migrate onto a secure foundation.
* Own **Entra ID security** — conditional access, Privileged Identity Management, workload identity governance, federation hardening with Okta, and tenant security.
* Co-own the onboarding and configuration of our **CNAPP platform** (e.g. Wiz, Cortex Cloud, Orca, or FortiCNAPP) — posture management policies, finding prioritisation, and workflow integration.
* Build and maintain **security controls as code** using Terraform and Azure Policy — CIS baselines, automated remediation, integrated into CI/CD.
* Ensure **on-prem Azure migrations** happen securely — risk assessment pre-migration, controls during, posture validation post.
* Conduct **threat modelling** for Azure infrastructure designs. Identify attack paths and prioritise controls based on actual risk.
* Automate **compliance evidence** collection for ISO 27001, GDPR, and DORA.
* Align Azure security patterns with **AWS and GCP** to maintain a coherent multi-cloud security posture. GCP security coverage will be shared with your peer as it matures.
* **Enable teams**: security design reviews, paved-road patterns, documentation, and office hours so cloud teams can self-serve securely.

Full remote in one of our European hubs (Germany, Netherlands, Denmark, Spain, Protugal), or Hybrid in one of our Hubs (Berlin, Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Madrid, Porto)

**About you**
-------------

### **Required**

* 8+ years of infrastructure or security engineering experience, with deep hands-on Azure security expertise at production scale.
* Ability to operate at staff level — technical authority, cross-team influence, and sound judgment. Prior staff/principal title not required, but you must demonstrate this level of impact.
* Strong Entra ID security expertise: conditional access, PIM, workload identity, federation hardening.
* Proven experience implementing Azure security controls: Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure Policy, network security, Key Vault.
* Infrastructure-as-code for security (**Terraform**) — policy-as-code, security modules, CI/CD integration.
* Threat modelling capability — reasoning about cloud attack paths, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
* Practical compliance framework implementation (ISO 27001, GDPR, DORA, or similar) — actual control automation, not just awareness.
* CNAPP/CSPM tooling experience (Wiz, Cortex Cloud, Orca, Prisma Cloud, Defender CSPM, or similar).
* Familiarity with observability platforms.
* Working knowledge of at least one other CSP (AWS or GCP) from a security perspective.
* Security detection experience with a SIEM (e.g. CrowdStrike, Splunk, Elastic, or native solutions like Sentinel or Google Security Operations).
* Ability to influence without authority — setting standards across teams.
* Excellent technical communication in English.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in fintech, banking, or regulated financial services.
* Okta + Entra ID federation security and cross-IdP governance.
* Post-acquisition security integration experience (tenant consolidation, inherited risk).
* DORA implementation experience.
* GCP security experience (future expansion area).
* On-prem / hybrid security experience.
* Supply chain security / CI/CD pipeline security.
* Relevant certifications: AZ-500, SC-300, AZ-305.

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

* Senior IC who leads through code, designs, reviews, and enablement — not standalone documents.
* Traversal role across all cloud teams — you partner with them, not sit above them.
* Tight collaboration with the Azure platform teams: you build a secure platform with them.
* Pragmatic: the secure path should be the easy path. Controls that teams bypass are not controls.
* Peer relationship with the AWS/IT Staff Engineer: shared strategy, separate domains.
* Success is measured by teams making good security decisions without you — build capability, not dependency.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**90 Days:** Assessed the current Azure security posture across all subscriptions. Defined the security architecture for the landing zone. Started CNAPP onboarding and initial policy configuration. First security controls deployed. Relationships built with all cloud teams.

**6 Months:** Landing zone security live — workloads migrating securely. CNAPP operationalised. Entra ID hardened. Security detection covering critical attack paths. Cross-cloud security standards aligned with AWS. Cloud teams self-serving on T2/T3 security decisions.

**12 Months:** Azure security at parity with AWS. Multiple workloads migrated securely. CNAPP providing continuous posture management. Compliance evidence automated. Teams making fewer security decisions that need your involvement. Contributing to GCP security expansion.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

**Our recruitment process**
---------------------------

1️⃣ Recruiter screen, have a initial conversation with Talent Acquisition

2️⃣ Hiring manager interview, dive deeper into the technical challenges of the team

3️⃣ Case interview, show your skills to one of your peers

4️⃣ Stakeholder interview, get a better idea of the collaborative environment

5️⃣ A personality assessment to round things off.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies - bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders - thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here.
  
As a Data Engineer at Sambla Group you will play a key role in building and maintaining the systems that power data-driven decision making across the company. You'll join a central Data Platform team, and work closely with an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager, contributing to everything from reliable data pipelines to enabling self-serve analytics and putting data to work in our operational tools.
  
We're building a modern, AI-native data platform, and we're looking for someone who doesn't just adapt to new tooling but actively drives how we adopt it. That means using AI-assisted development in your day-to-day work, exploring where LLMs and intelligent automation can make our platform smarter, and helping set the standard for how the team works with these tools going forward.

Design, build and maintain data pipelines and integrations (streaming, batch, API-based) that feed our data products
  
Develop and maintain our Data Warehouse and contribute to data platform improvements
  
Ensure data quality, data governance and GDPR compliance
  
Architect scalable and secure solutions in GCP and BigQuery
  
Use AI tooling to accelerate development and explore where it can add value across our data work
  
Collaborate with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams
  
  
**Must have:**  
At least 3 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role
  
Strong Python skills (e.g. Polars, Flask/FastAPI or similar)
  
Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex joins

Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows

Background in fintech or financial data
  
Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues
  
Ability to communicate confidently in Swedish
  
  
We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working - a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together. We call it Drive & Jive - a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Supply Team
description:
Hi! I’m Fedir, Engineering Manager for Team Supply at WeTravel

Our team’s mission is to turn WeTravel from a product into a network. Today a travel operator can run their own business on WeTravel. Next, we want them to plug into each other, co-selling trips, sharing itineraries, and settling commissions automatically, without a single spreadsheet or bank transfer in between. If you want to build the operating system an entire industry runs on, and to be in the room when we decide what that system should be, let’s build something we’re proud of, together!

**About WeTravel**
------------------

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we’re on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we’re building the engine to make more of that possible.

**What’s the role**
-------------------

Almost no travel operator works alone. Agents, B2C tour operators and destination management companies buy from suppliers, resell each other’s trips, and split the money afterwards. Today that all happens in spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and PDF quotes; Which is why pricing a trip takes days, and why nobody can tell you two years later how a number was calculated.

Team Supply is building the layer that replaces it. We’re five engineers, and a PM, working on the earliest part of WeTravel’s roadmap: first the single-player OS, how an operator designs a trip, prices it, and sells it, then the multiplayer layer that connects operators to their suppliers and to each other. Getting this right makes WeTravel the tool operators open every morning, and roughly doubles the market we can serve.

You’ll join us to build that foundation and take it from early access to something thousands of operators depend on. What’s on our plate:

* Quoting: a pricing engine in our new service: multiple currencies, tax regimes, margins, seasonal rates.
* Supplier & Product Catalog: a place where operators keep their suppliers, negotiated rates and reusable trip building blocks.
* The Partner Network: supplier onboarding, verification and payouts, so money moves between operators and their suppliers automatically.
* Next up, the explicitly multiplayer pieces: supplier arrangements, commission flows, and a booking marketplace.

It is, in effect, a startup inside a company that already has customers, revenue and scale, much closer to 0 1 than most senior roles you’ll look at this year.

**What you’ll do day-to-day**
-----------------------------

* Lead and build features end-to-end: from reviewing user interviews and product design, through architecture and building systems, to deployment and monitoring in production.
* Partner closely with our product team to discover user problems and shape their solutions, you’ll help decide what is worth building, not only how to build it.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code across both frontend (TypeScript/React) and backend (Ruby on Rails).
* Ensure our services are always on by building resilient applications, making sure they are well monitored, and mitigating incidents as an on-call/incident responder.
* Mentor teammates and contribute to WeTravel’s engineering practices and excellence.

**How we work**
---------------

* We’re focused on the impact. We don’t subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what’s impactful.
* We’re a distributed team: some of us in Amsterdam, the rest remote across Europe.
* We’re using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.
* Stack: We’re using React/ReactNative/TypeScript + Ruby on Rails and Python Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we’re working with the major LLM providers.

**You should apply if you have**
--------------------------------

**Basic qualifications**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience (ideally full-stack) with strong product ownership mindset
* Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, this one is a must. You’ve owned whole apps or large areas of a frontend, and you want to keep doing that.
* Solid backend experience in any recognized modern language: Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, .NET, Node/TypeScript, Ruby. Depth and engineering judgment matter to us more than the specific language.
* Built and launched something new in a startup or scale-up, and stayed with it as it grew (0 1 100)
* Breadth over narrow specialization: you’ve worked across the stack and across different kinds of problems, and you move to where the work is
* Experience building applications working with distributed systems, microservices and event-driven architecture, with strong systems thinking and an eye for scalability
* Experience operating applications in production: monitoring, alerting and on-call
* Excellent communication skills and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams
* Experience leading projects and mentoring other engineers
* Experience using AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Code, Codex etc

**Preferred qualifications**

* Ruby on Rails. It’s our backend stack, so it’s a plus, but we hire for general engineering strength and expect a strong engineer to pick it up.
* Experience in an adjacent domain: marketplaces, supplier or vendor networks, payments and fintech, travel-tech, B2B2C platforms, or quoting / booking / costing systems. A plus, never a requirement.
* Comfortable running your own infrastructure (AWS / Kubernetes)
* Building and maintaining component libraries and working with a design system; micro front-ends; React Native
* Recent experience in building AI-enabled or Agentic applications
* Direct experience with customer interviews and user research

**You might not be the right fit if you**
-----------------------------------------

* Prefer to work in isolation rather than working closely with product teams
* Are uncomfortable with end-to-end responsibility from conception to production monitoring
* Would rather receive well-specified tickets than help decide what to build
* Don’t enjoy learning new technologies or adapting to different tech stacks
* Are not interested in understanding user problems and business context
* Prefer purely technical roles without product ownership responsibilities
* Are uncomfortable with the ambiguity that comes with building new products in a growing team

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Make a real impact: you’ll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.
* Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.
* Be part of building the best engineering team: you’ll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.
* Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, remote-friendly work culture, and annual company offsites (our last one was in Italy ).

**Benefits**
------------

* Attractive compensation.
* Full-time - Fixed Term Contract (as International Contractor).
* Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.
* Amsterdam Program – visit us in Amsterdam (HQ) for 2-4 weeks every year, staying in one of our WeTravel apartments.
* Although this is a remote role, employees are hired into a designated country of employment. Our Work From Anywhere perk provides eligible employees with up to four weeks per calendar year to work temporarily from another approved location.
* Extensive paid family leave.
* Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.
* 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.
* Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success. Coverage for certain work-from-home (WFH) equipment.
* Cambly for colleagues for whom English is not their first language.
* Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

**Please note:**

* As a member of our international team, you’ll work full-time under a B2B contractor agreement, with monthly payments in USD.

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

The regulatory landscape (ViDA, Peppol, and national mandates) is changing faster than ever. For us, this isn't a compliance burden - it’s one of the biggest opportunities of the decade, and our R&D department sits right at the heart of it.

At Inexchange, we have well over 250 colleagues across the Nordics and are happy to welcome more. We are looking for two Engineering Managers to join our team and to lead our R&D teams to support global B2B e-invoicing**.**

#### **Your impact and responsibilities in this role**

As an Engineering Manager at Inexchange, you report to one of the Engineering Directors and will be responsible for around 8-12 engineers. This includes performance, development and day-to-day leadership.

* **Product & Delivery:** Own outcomes and delivery of products and align with product management on product discovery
* **People:** Lead and shape multiple teams across our locations in a remote
* **Talent & Development:** Coach and make development plans for all team members

#### **Who you are and what you bring to the role**

* **Experience:** Seasoned Manager with several years of experience in leading remote R&D teams
* **Background:** Not afraid to shape and lead the future of your team and R&D organisation through your extensive technical background
* **AI Native SDLC:** Have first hand experience with AI in the context of SW development

#### **Do you want to join our journey?**

Simple! Apply below, we review applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Are you good at seeing the full technical picture without losing sight of the details? Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, scalable solutions? And are you just as comfortable discussing architecture with developers and clients?

Then you might be the Senior Solution Architect we are looking for at Knowit.

As our Senior Solution Architect, you will help shape scalable and future-proof architecture for our clients’ digital platforms. We design and build complex web solutions for clients across many industries, and AI plays a growing part in that work. It shows up as intelligent features in the platforms we deliver and as a natural part of how our teams develop software.

You will be involved from the early stages of a project through implementation and continued development. Along the way, you will help connect business needs, user requirements and technical possibilities, making sure that our solutions work in practice and not just on paper.

**The role**

You will work closely with project managers, designers, UX professionals, developers, and clients. Together, you will turn requirements and ideas into digital solutions that are robust, maintainable, and ready to evolve.

In this role, AI is part of everyday work rather than a separate discipline. You will help decide when AI adds value to a solution, how it is integrated responsibly, and how our teams use AI tools without compromising quality, security or compliance.

Your responsibilities will include the following:

* Shaping the overall architecture for new and existing digital platforms

* Translating business requirements into clear technical solutions

* Making well-founded decisions about platforms, technologies and integrations

* Designing scalable and maintainable solutions across backend and frontend

* Defining how content platforms, APIs, AI services and third-party systems work together

* Assessing where AI adds value in a client solution and where a simpler approach serves the client better

* Driving the responsible use of AI-assisted development in our teams, including coding standards, guardrails and governance

* Identifying technical risks, dependencies and trade-offs early in the process, including data privacy and compliance considerations when AI is involved

* Contributing to technical estimates, workshops and client discussions

* Supporting high-quality delivery through coding standards, development practices and documentation

* Staying curious about new technologies and bringing relevant, well-evaluated ideas into our projects

And naturally, you will not be doing it alone. You will work alongside skilled colleagues across technology, design, UX and project management. We take shared responsibility for creating solutions that make sense for the client, the users, and the people who will maintain them afterwards.

**Who are you?**

You have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable moving between architecture, development and client dialogue.

You know that good architecture is not about choosing the most impressive technology. It is about understanding the problem, asking the right questions, and making decisions that create value over time. You approach AI the same way. You are curious and hands-on, you evaluate before you adopt, and you can explain both the potential and the limitations to a client in plain language.

You work in a structured way and can explain complex technical topics clearly. You are open about uncertainties, willing to challenge assumptions and curious enough to change your mind when a better solution appears.

**What we are looking for**

We hope you can cross of most of the following:

* At least five years of experience in web development or solution architecture, ideally from an agency or consultancy

* Hands-on experience across modern backend and frontend technologies in common languages, such as C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Python, or similar. Experience with .NET-based and CMS systems is a plus.

* A thorough understanding of common integration patterns and experience with integrations e.g. with CRM, ERP, PIM, CMS, gateways and other third-party systems

* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, and an informed view on how they fit into a professional delivery process

* Practical experience with CI/CD across different hosting models, from managed PaaS to containers and client-operated environments, e.g. pipeline design, quality gates, supply chain security

* An understanding of the compliance and governance side of AI/GDPR/NIS2 etc., including data privacy, security and the requirements that follow from regulation such as the EU AI Act

* Experience working with project managers, designers, UX professionals and clients to connect technical architecture with business needs.

* The ability to turn complex requirements into clear architectural decisions and practical technical plans in both project and bid scenarios.

* A structured approach to coding standards, development best practices and documentation

**About Knowit**

At the intersection of technology, creativity, and business, we help ambitious organizations make better use of digital opportunities.

You will become part of an interdisciplinary environment where developers, architects, designers, strategists, and project managers work closely together. We believe the best solutions are created when different perspectives meet and when people are open about both what they know and what they still need to learn.

**What can we offer you?**

At Knowit, you will have the opportunity to work on complex digital platforms and influence their technical direction from the beginning.

* Varied client projects with meaningful technical challenges

* A real say in how we adopt AI, from client solutions to our own development practices and governance

* Close collaboration across disciplines and direct dialogue with clients

* A high degree of trust, responsibility and influence

* Skilled colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other constructively

* Opportunities to develop your expertise and explore new technologies

* Flexibility and freedom to shape your working day

* An attractive salary and pension package

* A culture built on openness, curiosity and shared accountability

**Would you like to join Knowit?**

Instead of a traditional application, we would like to hear how you approach solution architecture in practice. You do not need to write at length or make it overly formal. Concrete experiences and honest reflections tell us much more than polished buzzwords.

**When you apply, we would like you to answer one or more of the questions below.**

* Tell us about a digital platform where you shaped or significantly changed the solution architecture. What challenge were you solving, which decisions and trade-offs did you make, and what was the outcome?

* Describe a project where you connect business needs with a complex technical landscape, such as a CMS, CRM, payment solution, APIs or other third-party systems. What was your role, and how did you arrive at an architecture that could work and evolve in practice?

* Give us an example of how you have used AI in your work, whether in a client solution or in your own development process. What worked, what did not, and how did you decide where to draw the line?

Use specific projects as context where possible and tell us what you would bring from those experiences into the role at Knowit.

Send us your CV and application through the application link. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the role or Knowit as a workplace, please contact People & Culture Consultant Katrine Gyldenskjold at katrine.gyldenskjold@knowit.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Are you looking for an opportunity where your Scrum Master expertise can drive real transformation, scaling a solutions delivery team to the next level within a strategic global manufacturing program?**

As our new **Scrum Master – Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Program**, you will be leading the transformation of our MES core solutions delivery team from project execution into a stable operations setup — facilitating agile ways of working across a diverse mix of business, IT and software development specialists delivering advanced manufacturing capabilities to Grundfos production sites worldwide.

**What you will be doing**

As a key part of the MES Program Core teams, you'll create impact on the transition from project to run organization and focus on delivering new features by separating operational and support tasks to a new MES Operation and Support team.

Your main responsibilities include:

* Lead the core solution delivery team and software development team of 20+ people, facilitating agile events and ensuring efficient development of the MES platform with program management
* Ensuring the right mix of specialist profiles in collaboration with people manager
* Drive continuous improvement by enhancing agile processes and ways of working tailored to evolving team needs
* Align priorities and the product roadmap with the business product owner and technical solution architect
* Serve as the key contact point to the broader IT organization supplying deliverables and services to the MES program

**What makes you a great fit**

Above all, you are an excellent communicator and facilitator who thrives in fast-changing environments, comfortable navigating complex team dynamics across global stakeholders while fostering collaboration, transparency, and commitment. We would also imagine that you have:

* Certified Scrum Master with a bachelor's or master's degree in IT or equivalent
* Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience with agile ways of working
* Experience with Azure DevOps or similar agile management tools
* Proficient in both English and Danish

It is a plus if you also:

* Experience working with multiple interdependent agile teams in a program setup
* Experience with IT/MES solutions for manufacturing industries
* Experience with process optimization methodologies

**Why you will love working here**

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.

Relocation not offered; applicants must live within driving distance of Bjerringbro.

**Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!**

*To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com*

title: Solution Architect – Digital Health
description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

**Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen**

**Solution Architect – Digital Health**

**Digital Engineering | Copenhagen**

**Shape the technical direction of complex digital solutions**

We are looking for experienced Solution Architects to join Twoday and help shape long-term, business-critical solutions within Danish digital healthcare.

These are complex application and integration landscapes where architecture is about more than selecting technologies. Solutions need to be secure, resilient and maintainable, integrate effectively with other systems and continue to evolve over many years.

Several development teams and suppliers will contribute to the overall delivery, making the ability to establish and communicate a coherent technical direction particularly important.

**What you will be doing**

As a Solution Architect, you will work at the intersection of business needs, software engineering, integration, security and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Translating business and technical requirements into robust solution architecture
* Designing application and integration architectures
* Defining and communicating architectural principles and technical guidelines
* Making and documenting architectural decisions
* Working closely with developers and other architects
* Ensuring coherence across applications, integrations, data and platforms
* Identifying technical risks, dependencies and opportunities for modernisation
* Contributing to the management and reduction of technical debt
* Ensuring that security and compliance considerations are reflected in solution design
* Creating technical alignment across teams and suppliers

The technology landscape may include Java and Open Source technologies, REST and SOAP, Kafka, RabbitMQ, microservices, event-driven architecture, Domain-Driven Design, OAuth2/OIDC, OIOSAML, Infrastructure as Code and containerised platforms.

Architecture is documented and communicated using relevant approaches such as C4 models and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

**What we are looking for**

You have professional experience as a Solution Architect, Software Architect or a highly experienced software developer with substantial architectural responsibility.

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have a strong understanding of software and integration architecture
* Have worked with distributed systems and APIs
* Understand event-driven architectures and messaging
* Can translate business needs into sound technical decisions
* Understand identity, access management and application security
* Can communicate complex technical decisions clearly to different audiences
* Can create alignment and commitment around architectural decisions
* Enjoy working closely with engineering teams rather than operating at a distance from implementation

Experience within digital healthcare, the public sector or other highly regulated and business-critical environments is a significant advantage.

Experience working in multi-supplier environments is also highly relevant, as the role requires you to create technical coherence across organisational boundaries.

Professional fluency in Danish, both spoken and written, is required. You must also be able to work onsite at the customer location in Copenhagen when required.

**Architecture that works in practice**

At Twoday, we believe architecture should enable engineering rather than constrain it.

You will join a strong professional environment where architects and engineers work closely together, combining long-term technical direction with an understanding of the realities development teams face every day.

**What we offer**

You will join Twoday as a permanent employee and become part of a strong professional community across software engineering, architecture, cloud and data.

You'll work on long-term, business-critical customer engagements and have the opportunity to develop your expertise across some of Denmark's most important digital solutions.

**About Twoday**

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions. You will also have the flexibility to occasionally work from one of our main offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki or Vilnius.

**Diversity & inclusion**

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:

Senior Solutions Architect
  
  
Do you want to be the technical authority behind Systematic's SitaWare portfolio within National Security & Infrastructure (NSI), shaping how national security and critical infrastructure organisations put it to work? As our new Senior Solutions Architect, you'll design end-to-end solutions and help our customers turn complex requirements into architecturally sound, scalable systems.
  
  
The job
  
  
As Senior Solutions Architect, you will be the technical authority for our SitaWare product suite within National Security & Infrastructure (NSI). You will design, guide, and validate end-to-end solutions across the full portfolio, bridging technical depth with operational understanding. You will translate market needs into concrete solution designs, while feeding product and development teams with real-world architectural insight.
  
  
**In short, some of your key tasks will be to:**  
define and drive the strategic direction of the Rezilient Suite built on top of the SitaWare platform
  
design and document end-to-end solution architectures that integrate multiple SitaWare components to meet customer requirements in national security and critical infrastructure
  
contribute to technical pre-sales engagements, including architecture workshops, solution scoping, proof-of-concept builds, and technical demonstrations
  
define and maintain reference architectures, integration patterns, and deployment blueprints across the SitaWare portfolio
  
support bid and proposal teams with technical solution content and architecture diagrams
  
mentor junior technical staff and field engineers on SitaWare platform capabilities and solution patterns.
  
  
Joining the team
  
You will join our NSI Product Management team, where technical rigour and domain knowledge are genuinely valued. Currently we are four architects and a product manager, proudly representing our domain and solutions. This is a high-autonomy, lead-level position with significant ownership of technical solution strategy, and your architectural feedback is taken seriously by engineering and product teams. You will work with market-leading command-and-control technology used by national security and critical infrastructure organisations and help shape how SitaWare capabilities are applied in emerging contexts across the domain.
  
  
You can read more about our National Security & Infrastructure business unit here: here and here.
  
  
Your qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, or an equivalent technical field
  
5+ years of experience in solutions architecture, ideally within command-and-control, situational awareness, or related software domains
  
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex, multi-component software solutions
  
Experience with GIS platforms, mapping frameworks, and geospatial data integration
  
Understanding of network and communications architectures relevant to operational environments.
  
  
You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken, and comfortable leading technical discussions with senior stakeholders. You can translate technical complexity into clear solution narratives, and you move easily between hands-on architecture work and strategic thinking.
  
  
Regular travel to customer sites, partner engagements, and our offices in Aarhus and Copenhagen should come naturally to you, including occasional international travel for workshops, demonstrations, and industry events.
  
  
Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years [to confirm this applies to this specific role] as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.
  
  
Welcome to Systematic Aarhus
  
At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.
  
  
Never stop developing
  
Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.
  
  
Start your development here
  
We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Ole Spielberg.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for a million of registered users across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new Engineering Manager you'll join our Cards & Topups team based in Aarhus, reporting to Girish Premchandran, working on future-proofing the cards platform.

**What will you do?**

* Lead two squads of senior engineers. Set direction, clear blockers, and give strong ICs room to do their best work. Match your leadership style to the person. Help them grow.
* Own platform outcomes across both squads: reliability, paved roads, productivity, quality, adoption. Hold internal teams to the same bar as any customer.
* Drive Lunar's shift to AI-native development. Take us from ad-hoc experiments to embedded practice, in the direction the industry calls the software factory. Handle the culture, tech, people, process, and regulatory sides (DORA and beyond).
* Help decide where the builder-productivity platform goes next, working closely with whoever defines what gets built and why.
* Partner with Product and other teams so technical priorities map straight to what customers need. Communicate often, set expectations early.

**What are we looking for in you?**

* 3-4 years leading engineering teams. You've helped senior ICs and tech leads set their own direction instead of directing from above. You've hired, coached, and managed performance.
* Platform engineering experience. You build for internal customers, think in leverage and adoption, and know the trade-offs of systems other teams rely on.
* Solid infrastructure chops. You know how systems get built, hosted, and scaled, and what pushes hosting and compute costs up or down.
* Real, hands-on experience with agentic coding tools, and genuine curiosity about where this goes next.
* A product instinct. You can say what a platform should do and why, set direction when things shift, and bring your team with you.

**What you get.**

* 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.
* State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.
* Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

**Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!**

While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we’re up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases , check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it’s like to work here .

*Depending on the regulations in the country where you will be employed, we will ask to see or obtain information about your criminal record.*

*We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know*

title: Technical Product Manager, Data Platform
description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for a million of registered users across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new Technical Product Manager for the Data Platform, you'll be one third of a leadership trio — alongside a Staff Architect and Engineering Manager — owning the product vision and strategy for one of Lunar's most critical foundations — the infrastructure that powers everything from real-time financial reporting to AI and ML. At Lunar, squads are autonomous with deep technical knowledge of their own — your job is to ask the right questions, not have all the answers.
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally financial services — you treat compliance and data governance as core responsibilities, not bureaucratic overhead

As Aker Solutions’ global recruitment partner NES Advantage is now looking for several: Electro Engineers in Kollsnes.
The end date is set in April 2031.
This is NOT a rotation.

From the start to end of production Aker Solutions ensures safe operations, optimizes field utilization, and enables field life-extensions. We do business development and execute modifications and maintenance projects. There is a global trend towards decarbonization, and we aim to help our customers to decarbonize their operations and measure their emissions to manage them more efficiently, for instance by delivering brownfield electrification of existing offshore facilities.
What will you be doing?
Follow up of Electrical Procurement Packages.
Co-ordinate with suppliers and review documents and drawings.
Engineering inputs to job packages.
As-builts of supplier drawings and red line mark-ups received from offshore.
Being responsible for electrical system engineering for LV consumers and switchboards.

title: Senior Plattform Utvikler - Strømmeplattform
description:
TET Digital AS

Dronningens gt. 40, 0154 Oslo

**Om jobben**
-------------

Lagre favoritt

Stillingstittel

Senior Plattform Utvikler - Strømmeplattform

Type ansettelse

Fast, heltid 100%

Antall stillinger

1

Arbeidsspråk

Norsk

Vis flere detaljer

Søk senest søndag 30. august

**Heisann!**

Vi er Tet Digital, et teknologiselskap eid av Ruter, Skyss og AKT. Hos oss jobber over 300 utviklere, designere, produktledere og spesialister innen data og sikkerhet som bygger digitale løsninger for bærekraftig mobilitet. Det du er med på å bygge her, brukes av veldig mange mennesker, hver eneste dag.

**Om Strømmeplattform teamet**

Strømmeteknologier som Kafka og MQTT er sentrale for de fleste applikasjoner hos Tet Digital. Enten det er snakk om estimater på ankomsttider, billettsalg eller miljødata går det aller meste via slik teknologi. Strømmeplattform-teamet har hovedansvaret for trygg, sikker, stabil og ikke minst enkel bruk av disse. Teamet opererer på flere nivåer: Vi evaluerer leverandører, overvåker bruksmønstre og stabilitet, vedlikeholder retningslinjer, bygger provisjonerings- og innsiktsverktøy, lager og leverer fellestjenester, og bistår med konkrete strømmeteknologi-relaterte problemer teamene måtte ha. Strømmeplattform-teamet er derfor et spesielt spennende sted å være for deg som liker å jobbe med det store bildet samtidig som du får utøvd praktisk håndverk.

#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**

**Om rollen**

Vi ser etter en erfaren senior plattformutvikler som kan ta teknisk eierskap til vår hendelsesdrevne plattform og bidra til å videreutvikle robuste, selvbetjente løsninger for utviklingsteamene våre.
  
Du har solid erfaring med backend-, plattform- eller infrastrukturutvikling, og du trives med å jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom applikasjoner, plattform og drift. Rollen passer deg som liker å bygge løsninger som mange team skal bruke, og som motiveres av å gjøre komplekse integrasjons- og infrastrukturproblemer enklere, tryggere og mer effektive å håndtere.
  
Vi forventer at du kan ta ansvar for teknisk retning, designe plattformkapabiliteter og være en faglig sparringspartner for både utviklere og andre plattformteam.

**Arbeidsoppgaver**

Dette vil du jobbe med:

* Bygge og videreutvikle plattformtjenester for hendelsesdrevet arkitektur og sanntidsdatabehandling
* Drifte og forbedre Kubernetes-baserte plattformmiljøer i skyen
* Automatisere infrastruktur og provisjonering ved hjelp av Terraform og annen infrastructure-as-code
* Utvikle selvbetjente løsninger for utviklingsteam, blant annet med Kubernetes-operatorer, kontrollere og plattformautomatisering
* Bidra til gode GitOps- og CI/CD-flyter som gjør det enkelt å levere sikkert og effektivt
* Feilsøke og optimalisere distribuerte systemer i produksjon, inkludert observability, logging og operasjonell innsikt
* Samarbeide tett med produkt- og utviklingsteam for å etablere gode "paved roads" og redusere manuell drift
* Bidra til å balansere robusthet, kostnad, sikkerhet, governance og utvikleropplevelse i plattformvalg og arkitektur

#### **Kvalifikasjoner**

**Vi ser etter deg som har:**

* Solid erfaring med backend-, plattform- eller infrastrukturutvikling
* Praktisk erfaring med Kubernetes og cloud-infrastruktur
* Erfaring med infrastructure-as-code, for eksempel Terraform
* Erfaring med Kafka eller tilsvarende meldings- eller streamingplattform
* Evne til å feilsøke distribuerte systemer i produksjon
* Erfaring med å skrive produksjonskode i minst ett relevant språk, for eksempel Go, Kotlin eller Java
* Gode norsk-, svensk- eller danskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig (minimum C1)
* Høyere utdanning innen IT, informatikk eller tilsvarende er relevant, men solid praktisk erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning

**Dette er områder vi jobber mye med i dag. Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra start, men interesse for å lære og utvikle deg innen disse temaene er viktig:**

* Kafka som plattform: Confluent Cloud eller andre managed Kafka-miljøer, topic-/ACL-provisioning, consumer groups, klientkonfigurasjon, feilsøking, observability, governance og kostnadsoptimalisering.
* Kafka-klienter og applikasjonsutvikling: Spring Boot, Spring Kafka eller Kafka Streams, Kotlin eller Java, samt forståelse for hvordan applikasjonskode oppfører seg mot Kafka i produksjon og rådgivning rundt klientkonfigurasjon, topic-bruk og feilhåndtering.
* Integrasjon og streaming: Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, MQTT og andre edge-/IoT-nære integrasjonsmønstre for sanntidsdata inn mot Kafka eller andre streamingløsninger.
* Plattformautomatisering: Kubernetes-operatorer og kontrollere, selvbetjente provisjoneringsløsninger, GitOps, CI/CD og utviklerportaler.

**Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:**

* Liker å bygge plattformkapabiliteter som mange team skal bruke
* Tenker helhetlig rundt robusthet, kostnad, sikkerhet og utvikleropplevelse
* Er nysgjerrig på hvordan Kafka og klienter faktisk oppfører seg i produksjon
* Foretrekker å lage gode standardløsninger fremfor å løse det samme problemet manuelt mange ganger
* Kan jobbe pragmatisk med eksisterende løsninger samtidig som du gradvis forbedrer plattformen
* Trives i tett samarbeid med både utviklere, plattformteam og drift

#### **Vi tilbyr**

**Det er ganske fint å jobbe i Tet Digital**

I Tet Digital er vi en gjeng på cirka 300 personer som holder til sentralt i Oslo sentrum sammen med Ruter. Vi ser for oss at du både kan jobbe litt her og litt hjemmefra, slik det passer deg. I tillegg får du gratis Ruter-billett for deg og familien, en halvtime kortere arbeidsdag, betalt mobilabonnement og internett hjemme, treningsstøtte, m.m. Subsidiert kantine som tilbyr deilige måltider til en rimelig pris, har vi også - slik at du kan nyte sunn og god mat hver dag! For å sikre både nysgjerrigheten og faglig utvikling, sørger vi for at du får mulighet til å bygge videre på kompetansen din. Vi prioriterer videreutvikling høyt og ser det som en viktig investering i både deg og vår felles fremtid.

**Høres dette ut som din neste match?**
  
Vi inviterer aktuelle kandidater til intervju fortløpende, så send oss gjerne din søknad i dag. Vi ber deg ikke bruke lang tid på søknadsbrevet. Skriv gjerne bare noen få setninger om deg selv. Vi er mer interessert i svarene dine på spørsmålene i spørreskjemaet vårt!

**Har du spørsmål om rollen?**

Ta gjerne kontakt med @Nicklas Pouey-Winger - Engineering Manager på nicklas.pouey-winger@tetdigital.no, eller Linh Nguyen - Rekrutteringsrådgiver på linh.nguyen@tetdigital.no.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Søknadsfrist: 30.08.2026. Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.
  
Arbeidsgiver: TET Digital AS
  
Sted: Oslo

**Om bedriften**
----------------

Tet Digital (Tet) er et teknologiselskap som driver digital tjenesteutvikling innen kollektivsektoren. Selskapet ble etablert 1. januar 2024 med mål om å utvikle og levere digitale kundeopplevelser innen bærekraftig mobilitet, og er eid av Ruter, Skyss og Agder Kollektivtrafikk (AKT). Tet bygger videre på den sterke arven fra Ruter og har solid erfaring med utvikling av anerkjente digitale løsninger, deriblant den velkjente Ruter-appen. Gjennom samarbeidet mellom flere kollektivtrafikkselskaper skaper Tet en sterk plattform for innovasjon og utvikling av fremtidens mobilitetsløsninger. Omtrent 69 prosent av alle kollektivreiser i Norge skjer gjennom digitale tjenester som Tet leverer, noe som gjør selskapet til en sentral aktør i utviklingen av landets digitale mobilitetsløsninger. Tet skal styrke eiernes evne til å utvikle mobilitetstilbudet og løse sitt samfunnsoppdrag gjennom å profesjonalisere og effektivisere drift av felles digitale mobilitetsløsninger og digital infrastruktur, videreutvikle og skape nye markedsledende digitale tjenester, samt være eiernes ledende innovasjonsmiljø innen utvikling av teknologi som støtter bærekraftige mobilitetstjenester. Ved å gjøre utviklingen av digital infrastruktur til noe flere fylkeskommuner eier sammen, får vi delte kostnader, samarbeid om innovasjon og en styrket posisjon til å levere gode løsninger.

Are you our new HVAC Engineering Manager?
About the position
Novenco AS, the Norwegian entity of the Novenco Marine & Offshore group, is looking for an experienced HVAC Engineering Manager to lead and develop our HVAC Engineering Department of 11 engineers. The working location is at Novenco AS, Trollåsen, Norway. Occasional international travel is required. The position reports to the Managing Director of Novenco AS, and is a member of the Leadership Team.
This is a leadership role with responsibility for people, performance, and competence development. You will drive the delivery and continuous development of competitive HVAC solutions and products aligned with our business goals, while building the engineering capabilities needed to support growth in offshore, defence, marine, and future nuclear and data center markets.
We are looking for a leader with strong people management experience, relevant education, and solid HVAC engineering and product expertise from industries similar to Novenco. The role includes participation in Novenco Marine & Offshore's technical committees, collaborating with colleagues across Norway, Denmark, and China to continuously improve group performance.
You must identify with our values and live by them in your daily work:
Customer Focus, Commitment, Performance, Cooperation, and Respect.
Tasks and Responsibilities:
Lead and develop the HVAC Engineering Department and its people
Build HVAC engineering and product competences to support current and future markets
Ensure competitive, efficient and customer-focused HVAC engineering and product deliverables aligned with our strategy and business goals
Participate in Novenco Marine & Offshore’s technical committees as found relevant
Qualifications:
Relevant formal education, e.g. Bachelor's/Master's degree
Proven experience leading technical teams within marine, offshore, defence or related industries
Strong HVAC engineering and product competences
Experience delivering engineering work in project-based organizations
Commercial understanding
Experience from international and multidisciplinary environments is an advantage
Fluent English, both written and spoken
Personal Qualifications:
Motivated by developing people, building teams and creating strong performance cultures
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
Comfortable with setting expectations, goals and following up
Curious, open-minded and able to quickly understand complex technical and organizational matters
Interest in new technology
Customer focused
Confident and resilient in driving change
We offer:
At Novenco, you will have opportunities for both professional and personal development.
Our Leadership Team is committed to developing people through goal setting, follow-up, support, feedback, training and coaching.
We offer long-term career opportunities within an international organization.
Our office at Rosenholm Campus offers a modern working environment with a high-quality canteen, conference center, gym, game room, and indoor parking with EV charging facilities, just a 10-minute walk from the train/bus station.
Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home.
A positive, collaborative, and social work environment.
If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply as soon as possible and no later than August 31, 2026.

title: Senior Project Engineer
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Engineering Manager

\_\_

**Er du en erfaren automasjonsingeniør som ønsker å jobbe med avanserte kontrollsystemer og komplekse prosjekter i energisektoren? Hos ABB i Hammerfest får du en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av morgendagens industrielle løsninger.**

Vi søker dyktige fagfolk til vårt team i Hammerfest, hvor vi driver integrerte løsninger for å automatisere, digitalisere og elektrifisere industrier. Med over 50 års ekspertise innen vårt felt, er vi i forkant av innovasjon, og omformer tradisjonelle tilnærminger for å forbedre driftseffektiviteten og redusere miljøpåvirkningen.

**Hvorfor jobbe for ABB i Hammerfest?**

Vi har spennende og utfordrende oppdrag på **Hammerfest LNG, Goliat FPSO og Johan Castberg**. Vi tilbyr et stimulerende og dynamisk arbeidsmiljø hvor du kan arbeide med banebrytende prosjekter, bidra til bærekraft, og nyte positive arbeidsforhold, samtidig som du får muligheter for personlig og profesjonell vekst.

Som **Senior Prosjektingeniør** vil du være en nøkkelperson på prosjekter for norske og internasjonale kunder og leverandører innen segmenter som ny energileveranse og landbasert industri.

**Dine ansvarsområder**

* Design, implementering, igangkjøring og service av kontrollsystemer
* Delta i installasjon, igangkjøring og serviceoppdrag
* Utvikle automatiseringsløsninger på ABBs kontrollsystemer 800xA
* Programmere PLS og designe HMI
* Etablere systemdesign og dokumentere løsninger i henhold til kundens krav

**Dine kvalifikasjoner og bakgrunn**

* Ingeniørgrad (B.Sc./M.Sc.) innen automatisering, kybernetikk, IT eller lignende
* Forståelse for kontrollsystemer, HW-design og prosessautomatisering
* Fleksibilitet, ansvarsfølelse, initiativ og gode samarbeidsevner
* Evne til å arbeide strukturert, systematisk, selvstendig og i team
* God skandinavisk språkferdighet og flytende i skriftlig og muntlig engelsk

**Viktig informasjon om sikkerhetsklarering**  
Denne stillingen innebærer arbeid på prosjekter og anlegg med særskilte sikkerhetskrav. Det er derfor en forutsetning for ansettelse at du kan sikkerhetsklareres i henhold til gjeldende krav fra norske myndigheter og våre kunder. Endelig tilbud om ansettelse vil være betinget av at nødvendig sikkerhetsklarering kan oppnås.

**Noe av det vi tilbyr deg, er:**

* Konkurransedyktige fordeler og fleksible arbeidstider
* Karriereutvikling gjennom opplæring og utviklingsprogrammer
* Inkluderende arbeidsmiljø som verdsetter mangfold
* Innovasjon og teknologi i forkant av bransjen
* Muligheter for nasjonale og internasjonale oppdrag og samarbeid

**Virker dette interessant?** Send inn din søknad og CV innen **30.8.2026**. Har du spørsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte avdelingsleder Sten Viktor Hakonsen, stenviktor.hakonsen@no.abb.com.

ABB er leverandør av samfunnskritisk infrastruktur. Personellsikkerhet er derfor viktig for ABB og våre kunder. I samarbeid med Meditor, gjennomfører ABB Norge bakgrunnssjekk av kandidater som mottar tilbud om ansettelse. Dette for å sikre overholdelse av ABBs retningslinjer for rekruttering og personellsikkerhet, samt overholdelse av lovkrav knyttet til handelssanksjoner. Kandidater vil bli bedt om å avgi relevant informasjon.

***ABB*** *er en global teknologileder innen elektrifisering og automasjon, som muliggjør en mer bærekraftig og ressurseffektiv fremtid. Ved å kombinere sin ekspertise innen teknologi og digitalisering, hjelper ABB industrier med å prestere på et høyt nivå, samtidig som de blir mer effektive, produktive, bærekraftige og i stand til å øke sin konkurransekraft. Hos ABB kaller vi dette "Engineered to Outrun". Selskapet har over 140 års historie og rundt 110 000 ansatte over hele verden.* *ABBs aksjer er notert på SIX Swiss Exchange (ABBN) og Nasdaq Stockholm (ABB).*

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Med Ruter som fundament har vi lang erfaring med å utvikle anerkjente digitale produkter, som Ruter-appen. Sammen lager vi løsninger som gjør at Fredrik fra Bergen kommer seg på trening, Aisha fra Torshov rekker barnehagehenting, og Nora fra Vennesla når jobbintervjuet i tide.
Nå ser vi etter en Staff Engineer som vil få en helt sentral rolle i hvordan vi bygger teknologi fremover.
Om rollen og din hverdag
Som Staff Engineer eier du den overordnede arkitekturen i ditt produktområde og bidrar til å sette teknisk retning på tvers av hele Tet. Du kombinerer dyp arkitektur- og engineeringkompetanse med sterk bruker- og produkttenkning, og du opptrer som en strateg når du balanserer kortsiktige behov og drift mot langsiktig innovasjon.
I første omgang vil du jobbe i produktområdet Reiserett og betaling, hvor kjernetjenestene for billetter, ordre og betalingsløsninger bor. Her får du en nøkkelrolle med et dobbelt mandat:
I produktområdet: Du sitter i områdeledelsen sammen med Engineering Manager, Design Lead, Produktområdeleder og Data- og innsiktslead. Du støtter områdets Tech Leads og utviklere, og fungerer som en katalysator som sikrer at teamene ser felles muligheter, bygger helhetlige løsninger og unngår å tråkke i beina på hverandre.
I Team Arkitektur: Du blir en del av det overordnede arkitekturmiljøet på tvers av Tet. Sammen med andre Staff Engineers setter du premissene for hele selskapets teknologivalg og tekniske retning.
Dine viktigste oppgaver blir å:
Forme helhetlig arkitektur: Ha ansvaret for en tydelig, robust og skalerbar arkitektur i produktområdet ditt, designet for lavest mulig driftstetthet i produksjon.
Legge til rette for innovasjon: Sørge for at arkitekturen gjør at produktteamene kan bygge, teste og innovere raskt og trygt.
Sette teknisk retning: Ta gode strategiske teknologivalg og sikre en felles standard på tvers av team og domener.
Drive prioriteringer: Ha medansvar for produktområdets roadmap, tekniske prioriteringer og strategiske beslutninger.
Bygge fag og folk: Bidra til å bygge et sterkt teknologimiljø, heve kvaliteten i faget og sparre med utviklerne i det daglige.
Hvem er du?
Du trenger ikke være som oss, og forhåpentligvis kommer du inn med nye perspektiver som vi gleder oss til å lytte til.
Vi ser etter deg som har en dyp teknisk ballast, men som samtidig vet at de beste arkitekturvalgene blir til gjennom samarbeid og god lytting. Du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom fag og folk, og har en trygg, pedagogisk evne til å forklare komplekse tekniske utfordringer for ulike målgrupper.
Du er en pragmatisk problemløser med god forretningsforståelse. Du skjønner at man sjelden kan bygge alt "etter læreboka" fra dag én, og har mot og klokskap til å gjøre skarpe, trygge prioriteringer når det trengs. I en vekst- og utviklingsfase med høyt tempo ser du endringer og nye retninger som muligheter fremfor stress.
Framfor alt motiveres du av å gjøre teamene rundt deg gode, og å skape en arkitektur som faktisk hjelper folk å levere bedre i hverdagen.
Vi tror du lykkes hvis du har:
Utdanning: Relevant høyere utdanning innen informatikk, datateknologi eller tilsvarende. Lang erfaring kan veie opp for formell utdannelse.
Solid teknologisk fundament: Minimum fem års erfaring med effektiv utvikling av digitale løsninger, smidige metoder og kontinuerlig leveranse, der du har balanse mellom tempo, kvalitet og bærekraft.
Produktfokus: Minimum fem års erfaring fra en produktorientert organisasjon, med dyp forståelse for samspillet mellom produkt, design, teknologi og data.
Arkitektur som styringsverktøy: God erfaring med dokumentasjon og modellering av løsningsarkitektur, dataflyt, integrasjoner og systemlandskap i større skala.
Leder- og strategierfaring: Flere års relevant erfaring fra teknisk ledelse, arkitekturledelse eller tilsvarende roller, med deltakelse i ledergrupper eller strategiske fora.
Språk: Gode kommunikasjonsevner skriftlig og muntlig på et skandinavisk språk (norsk, svensk eller dansk – minimum C1), da norsk er arbeidsspråket vårt.
Det er ganske fint å jobbe i Tet
I Tet Digital er vi en gjeng på cirka 300 personer som holder til sentralt i Oslo sentrum sammen med Ruter. I tillegg får du gratis Ruter-billett for deg og familien, en halvtime kortere arbeidsdag (!), treningsstøtte, subsidiert kantine og et raus kompetansebudsjett, i tillegg til mange andre goder.

Send oss en søknad, så tar vi en prat! Vi rekrutterer fortløpende.

PALFINGER Marine Norway Offshore Cranes, Winches, Handling and Access Equipment (OC & WHA) group are strengthen the engineering team with a team leader position for the control system department.

Join our Engineering team in Bergen (Nesttun) and lead a skilled group of Control System & Automation Engineers across Norway and Poland. As Team Lead, you will manage people, drive technical solutions, and contribute hands‑on to cutting‑edge offshore and marine equipment development.

**Heisann!**

Vi er Tet Digital, et teknologiselskap eid av Ruter, Skyss og AKT. Det du er med på å bygge her, brukes av veldig mange mennesker, hver eneste dag.
  
Om IAM Platform-teamet

Vi etablerer et dedikert IAM Platform-team. Teamet bygger, drifter og forvalter en felles plattform for innlogging og tilgangsstyring for alle løsninger Tet utvikler, enten det gjelder millioner av sluttbrukere eller partnerorganisasjoner som administrerer sine egne ansatte og tilganger.I dag er identitet og tilgang spredt over flere separate løsninger uten felles styring. Vi sentraliserer alt dette i én plattform, og du blir en av de første som setter den opp. Teamet er lite og nyetablert, og du vil ha reell påvirkning på tekniske valg og retning fra første dag. Vi er i ferd med å velge hvilken IAM-plattform produkt vi går videre med, og vi sier ikke på forhånd hva det blir. Det er en del av jobben du går inn i. Det kan bli en åpen kildekode-løsning, en selvdriftet plattform eller noe annet. Det vi vet er at løsningen skal bygge på åpne standarder og integrere med eksisterende identitetsleverandører hos partnerne våre. Erfaring fra én IAM-plattform gir nyttig ballast uansett hvilken vi velger, men forståelsen av domenet teller mest.

**Om IAM Platform-teamet**
