Vi er i ferd med å velge hvilken IAM-plattform produkt vi går videre med, og vi sier ikke på forhånd hva det blir. Det er en del av jobben du går inn i. Det kan bli en åpen kildekode-løsning, en selvdriftet plattform eller noe annet. Det vi vet er at løsningen skal bygge på åpne standarder og integrere med eksisterende identitetsleverandører hos partnerne våre. Erfaring fra én IAM-plattform gir nyttig ballast uansett hvilken vi velger, men forståelsen av domenet teller mest.

#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**

**Om rollen**
  
Vi ser etter én eller to plattformutviklere med god domenekunnskap om identitet og tilgangsstyring, én på seniornivå og én på mellomnivå. Du forstår IAM som fagfelt, vet hvordan tilgangskontroll fungerer i praksis og kan hjelpe utviklingsteam med å ta løsningen i bruk. På seniornivå forventer vi at du kan eie den tekniske retningen, designe tilgangskontrollmodeller og lede integrasjonsarbeidet på tvers av team. På mellomnivå ser vi etter deg som har en solid plattformutvikler bakgrunn, vil gå i dybden på IAM-domenet og er motivert av å vokse inn i et felt du ikke nødvendigvis behersker fullt ut ennå.

**Arbeidsoppgaver**

Dette vil du jobbe med:

* Drifte og videreutvikle en felles IAM-plattform med støtte for åpne standarder: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML, SCIM og WebAuthn/passkeys
* Designe og implementere rollemodeller (RBAC) for applikasjoner med ulike brukerkontekster, og vurdere attributtbasert tilgangskontroll (ABAC) der det gir mening
* Hjelpe produktteam med å integrere seg mot plattformen i språkene de bruker, og bidra med bibliotekvalg, token-håndtering og autentiseringsflyter tilpasset deres stack
* Håndtere partner-onboarding og federering mot eksisterende identitetsleverandører i partnerorganisasjonene
* Forvalte konfigurasjon og hemmeligheter etter GitOps-prinsipper
* Etablere audit-logging og overvåkning, og bidra til at plattformen er enkel å bruke riktig og vanskelig å bruke feil
* Bidra til migrering fra dagens fragmenterte løsninger til den nye, samlede plattformen

#### **Kvalifikasjoner**

**Vi ser etter deg som har:**

* God forståelse for identitet og tilgangsstyring som fagfelt: brukere, roller, grupper, claims, scopes og token-livssyklus
* Praktisk erfaring med RBAC-design og -implementasjon; kjennskap til ABAC eller relasjonsbasert tilgangskontroll er et pluss
* Solid kjennskap til OAuth 2.0 og OIDC; erfaring med SAML og federering er en fordel
* Evne til å møte utviklingsteam der de er og hjelpe dem med integrasjon i ulike språk og rammeverk, ikke bare peke på dokumentasjon
* Erfaring med Kubernetes og GitOps-basert drift
* Gode norsk-, svensk- eller danskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig (minimum C1)
* Høyere utdanning innen IT, sikkerhet eller informatikk er relevant, men solid erfaring teller minst like mye

**For seniornivå ser vi i tillegg etter:**

* Erfaring med å designe tilgangskontrollmodeller i systemer med flere brukerkontekster, gjerne både sluttbrukere og partnerorganisasjoner
* Evne til å forankre tekniske valg hos produktteam og plattformledelse
* Erfaring med å lede migrering fra én IAM-løsning til en annen

#### **Vi tilbyr**

**Det er ganske fint å jobbe i Tet Digital**

I Tet Digital er vi en gjeng på cirka 300 personer som holder til sentralt i Oslo sentrum sammen med Ruter. Vi ser for oss at du både kan jobbe litt her og litt hjemmefra, slik det passer deg. I tillegg får du gratis Ruter-billett for deg og familien, en halvtime kortere arbeidsdag, betalt mobilabonnement og internett hjemme, treningsstøtte, m.m. Subsidiert kantine som tilbyr deilige måltider til en rimelig pris, har vi også - slik at du kan nyte sunn og god mat hver dag! For å sikre både nysgjerrigheten og faglig utvikling, sørger vi for at du får mulighet til å bygge videre på kompetansen din. Vi prioriterer videreutvikling høyt og ser det som en viktig investering i både deg og vår felles fremtid.

**Høres dette ut som din neste match?**
  
Vi inviterer aktuelle kandidater til intervju fortløpende, så send oss gjerne din søknad i dag. Vi ber deg ikke bruke lang tid på søknadsbrevet. Skriv gjerne bare noen få setninger om deg selv. Vi er mer interessert i svarene dine på spørsmålene i spørreskjemaet vårt!

**Har du spørsmål om rollen?**

Ta gjerne kontakt med @Nicklas Pouey-Winger - Engineering Manager på nicklas.pouey-winger@tetdigital.no, eller Linh Nguyen - Rekrutteringsrådgiver på linh.nguyen@tetdigital.no.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

title: Senior Prosjektingeniør – Cyber Security
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Senior Engineering Manager

\_\_

**Bli en del av et globalt team som bidrar til å forme en mer produktiv og bærekraftig fremtid gjennom teknologi og innovasjon.**

Vi søker en **Senior Prosjektingeniør til vårt Cyber, IT- og Nettverks team i Stavanger**. Rollen har hovedfokus på etablering, sikring og vedlikehold av den tekniske infrastrukturen som understøtter industrielle kontrollsystemer. Du vil arbeide med servere, nettverk, brannmurer og virtuelle miljøer, og bidra til at våre kunder får stabile, sikre og fremtidsrettede OT-løsninger. Samtidig blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø der samarbeid, kunnskapsdeling og personlig utvikling står sentralt.

**Dine arbeidsoppgaver**

* Etablere, konfigurere og vedlikeholde OT-infrastruktur for industrielle kontroll- og automasjonssystemer.
* Implementere og administrere servere, nettverk, brannmurer og virtuelle miljøer som understøtter kritiske produksjons- og kontrollsystemer.
* Planlegge og gjennomføre oppgraderinger av servere, nettverkskomponenter og sikkerhetsløsninger.
* Bidra til sikker drift og vedlikehold av kundenes OT- og cybersikkerhetsmiljøer.
* Feilsøke og løse tekniske utfordringer knyttet til nettverk, servere, virtualiseringsplattformer og sikkerhetsløsninger.
* Integrere og sikre industrielle kontrollsystemer i henhold til kundekrav og relevante standarder som IEC 62443.
* Delta i prosjektgjennomføring fra design og implementering til testing, idriftsettelse og overlevering.
* Samarbeide tett med kollegaer innen cyber security, IT, automasjon og andre fagområder for å levere robuste og sikre løsninger.
* Bidra til kompetansedeling, kontinuerlig forbedring og utvikling av fagmiljøet.

**Din bakgrunn**

* Bachelor- eller mastergrad innen IT, nettverk, cybersikkerhet, automasjon eller tilsvarende.
* Erfaring med serveradministrasjon, virtualisering, nettverk eller cybersikkerhet i industrielle eller tekniske miljøer.
* God forståelse for nettverksarkitektur, brannmurer, switcher, servere og virtuelle plattformer.
* Erfaring med OT-nettverk eller industrielle kontrollsystemer er en fordel.
* Kunnskap om eller erfaring med IEC 62443 er ønskelig.
* Evne til å arbeide strukturert, både selvstendig og i team.
* Gode kommunikasjonsevner på engelsk. Norsk er en fordel.

**Vi tilbyr**

* Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i et sterkt fagmiljø.
* Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer som støtter og lærer av hverandre.
* Gode karrieremuligheter gjennom faglig utvikling, kompetanseheving og spennende prosjekter.
* Fleksible arbeidsordninger og mulighet til å påvirke egne arbeidsoppgaver og ansvar.
* En arbeidsplass som verdsetter trivsel, tillit og god balanse mellom jobb og fritid.
* Muligheter for offshoreoppdrag.

**Arbeidssted:**

ABBs kontor på Forus i Sandnes. For mer informasjon om stillingen, vennligst ta kontakt med Magnus Lysen, magnus.lysen@no.abb.com.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad senest **30. august**. Vi vil kun godta søknader som sendes via vår karriereportal. Søknader via e-post vil ikke behandles, og må slettes i tråd med krav til personvern.

**ABB** er leverandør av samfunnskritisk infrastruktur. Personellsikkerhet er derfor viktig for ABB og våre kunder. I samarbeid med Meditor, gjennomfører ABB Norge bakgrunnssjekk av kandidater som mottar tilbud om ansettelse. Dette for å sikre overholdelse av ABBs retningslinjer for rekruttering og personellsikkerhet, samt overholdelse av lovkrav knyttet til handelssanksjoner. Kandidater vil bli bedt om å avgi relevant informasjon.

***ABB*** *er en global teknologileder innen elektrifisering og automasjon, som muliggjør en mer bærekraftig og ressurseffektiv fremtid. Ved å kombinere sin ekspertise innen teknologi og digitalisering, hjelper ABB industrier med å prestere på et høyt nivå, samtidig som de blir mer effektive, produktive, bærekraftige og i stand til å øke sin konkurransekraft. Hos ABB kaller vi dette "Engineered to Outrun". Selskapet har over 140 års historie og rundt 110 000 ansatte over hele verden. ABBs aksjer er notert på SIX Swiss Exchange (ABBN) og Nasdaq Stockholm (ABB).*

Senior Plattform Utvikler - Strømmeplattform
Heisann!
Vi er Tet Digital, et teknologiselskap eid av Ruter, Skyss og AKT. Hos oss jobber over 300 utviklere, designere, produktledere og spesialister innen data og sikkerhet som bygger digitale løsninger for bærekraftig mobilitet. Det du er med på å bygge her, brukes av veldig mange mennesker, hver eneste dag.
Om Strømmeplattform teamet
Strømmeteknologier som Kafka og MQTT er sentrale for de fleste applikasjoner hos Tet Digital. Enten det er snakk om estimater på ankomsttider, billettsalg eller miljødata går det aller meste via slik teknologi. Strømmeplattform-teamet har hovedansvaret for trygg, sikker, stabil og ikke minst enkel bruk av disse. Teamet opererer på flere nivåer: Vi evaluerer leverandører, overvåker bruksmønstre og stabilitet, vedlikeholder retningslinjer, bygger provisjonerings- og innsiktsverktøy, lager og leverer fellestjenester, og bistår med konkrete strømmeteknologi-relaterte problemer teamene måtte ha. Strømmeplattform-teamet er derfor et spesielt spennende sted å være for deg som liker å jobbe med det store bildet samtidig som du får utøvd praktisk håndverk.
Arbeidsoppgaver
Om rollen
Vi ser etter en erfaren senior plattformutvikler som kan ta teknisk eierskap til vår hendelsesdrevne plattform og bidra til å videreutvikle robuste, selvbetjente løsninger for utviklingsteamene våre.
Du har solid erfaring med backend-, plattform- eller infrastrukturutvikling, og du trives med å jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom applikasjoner, plattform og drift. Rollen passer deg som liker å bygge løsninger som mange team skal bruke, og som motiveres av å gjøre komplekse integrasjons- og infrastrukturproblemer enklere, tryggere og mer effektive å håndtere.
Vi forventer at du kan ta ansvar for teknisk retning, designe plattformkapabiliteter og være en faglig sparringspartner for både utviklere og andre plattformteam.
Arbeidsoppgaver
Dette vil du jobbe med:
Bygge og videreutvikle plattformtjenester for hendelsesdrevet arkitektur og sanntidsdatabehandling
Drifte og forbedre Kubernetes-baserte plattformmiljøer i skyen
Automatisere infrastruktur og provisjonering ved hjelp av Terraform og annen infrastructure-as-code
Utvikle selvbetjente løsninger for utviklingsteam, blant annet med Kubernetes-operatorer, kontrollere og plattformautomatisering
Bidra til gode GitOps- og CI/CD-flyter som gjør det enkelt å levere sikkert og effektivt
Feilsøke og optimalisere distribuerte systemer i produksjon, inkludert observability, logging og operasjonell innsikt
Samarbeide tett med produkt- og utviklingsteam for å etablere gode "paved roads" og redusere manuell drift
Bidra til å balansere robusthet, kostnad, sikkerhet, governance og utvikleropplevelse i plattformvalg og arkitektur
Kvalifikasjoner
Vi ser etter deg som har:
Solid erfaring med backend-, plattform- eller infrastrukturutvikling
Praktisk erfaring med Kubernetes og cloud-infrastruktur
Erfaring med infrastructure-as-code, for eksempel Terraform
Erfaring med Kafka eller tilsvarende meldings- eller streamingplattform
Evne til å feilsøke distribuerte systemer i produksjon
Erfaring med å skrive produksjonskode i minst ett relevant språk, for eksempel Go, Kotlin eller Java
Gode norsk-, svensk- eller danskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig (minimum C1)
Høyere utdanning innen IT, informatikk eller tilsvarende er relevant, men solid praktisk erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning
Dette er områder vi jobber mye med i dag. Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra start, men interesse for å lære og utvikle deg innen disse temaene er viktig:
Kafka som plattform: Confluent Cloud eller andre managed Kafka-miljøer, topic-/ACL-provisioning, consumer groups, klientkonfigurasjon, feilsøking, observability, governance og kostnadsoptimalisering.
Kafka-klienter og applikasjonsutvikling: Spring Boot, Spring Kafka eller Kafka Streams, Kotlin eller Java, samt forståelse for hvordan applikasjonskode oppfører seg mot Kafka i produksjon og rådgivning rundt klientkonfigurasjon, topic-bruk og feilhåndtering.
Integrasjon og streaming: Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, MQTT og andre edge-/IoT-nære integrasjonsmønstre for sanntidsdata inn mot Kafka eller andre streamingløsninger.
Plattformautomatisering: Kubernetes-operatorer og kontrollere, selvbetjente provisjoneringsløsninger, GitOps, CI/CD og utviklerportaler.
Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:
Liker å bygge plattformkapabiliteter som mange team skal bruke
Tenker helhetlig rundt robusthet, kostnad, sikkerhet og utvikleropplevelse
Er nysgjerrig på hvordan Kafka og klienter faktisk oppfører seg i produksjon
Foretrekker å lage gode standardløsninger fremfor å løse det samme problemet manuelt mange ganger
Kan jobbe pragmatisk med eksisterende løsninger samtidig som du gradvis forbedrer plattformen
Trives i tett samarbeid med både utviklere, plattformteam og drift
Vi tilbyr
Det er ganske fint å jobbe i Tet Digital
I Tet Digital er vi en gjeng på cirka 300 personer som holder til sentralt i Oslo sentrum sammen med Ruter. Vi ser for oss at du både kan jobbe litt her og litt hjemmefra, slik det passer deg. I tillegg får du gratis Ruter-billett for deg og familien, en halvtime kortere arbeidsdag, betalt mobilabonnement og internett hjemme, treningsstøtte, m.m. Subsidiert kantine som tilbyr deilige måltider til en rimelig pris, har vi også – slik at du kan nyte sunn og god mat hver dag! For å sikre både nysgjerrigheten og faglig utvikling, sørger vi for at du får mulighet til å bygge videre på kompetansen din. Vi prioriterer videreutvikling høyt og ser det som en viktig investering i både deg og vår felles fremtid.
Høres dette ut som din neste match?
Vi inviterer aktuelle kandidater til intervju fortløpende, så send oss gjerne din søknad i dag. Vi ber deg ikke bruke lang tid på søknadsbrevet. Skriv gjerne bare noen få setninger om deg selv. Vi er mer interessert i svarene dine på spørsmålene i spørreskjemaet vårt!
Har du spørsmål om rollen?
Ta gjerne kontakt med @Nicklas Pouey-Winger - Engineering Manager på nicklas.pouey-winger@tetdigital.no, eller Linh Nguyen - Rekrutteringsrådgiver på linh.nguyen@tetdigital.no.
Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren
Tet Digital (Tet) er et teknologiselskap som driver digital tjenesteutvikling innen kollektivsektoren. Selskapet ble etablert 1. januar 2024 med mål om å utvikle og levere digitale kundeopplevelser innen bærekraftig mobilitet, og er eid av Ruter, Skyss og Agder Kollektivtrafikk (AKT). Tet bygger videre på den sterke arven fra Ruter og har solid erfaring med utvikling av anerkjente digitale løsninger, deriblant den velkjente Ruter-appen. Gjennom samarbeidet mellom flere kollektivtrafikkselskaper skaper Tet en sterk plattform for innovasjon og utvikling av fremtidens mobilitetsløsninger. Omtrent 69 prosent av alle kollektivreiser i Norge skjer gjennom digitale tjenester som Tet leverer, noe som gjør selskapet til en sentral aktør i utviklingen av landets digitale mobilitetsløsninger. Tet skal styrke eiernes evne til å utvikle mobilitetstilbudet og løse sitt samfunnsoppdrag gjennom å profesjonalisere og effektivisere drift av felles digitale mobilitetsløsninger og digital infrastruktur, videreutvikle og skape nye markedsledende digitale tjenester, samt være eiernes ledende innovasjonsmiljø innen utvikling av teknologi som støtter bærekraftige mobilitetstjenester. Ved å gjøre utviklingen av digital infrastruktur til noe flere fylkeskommuner eier sammen, får vi delte kostnader, samarbeid om innovasjon og en styrket posisjon til å levere gode løsninger.

description:
MAKE HISTORY WITH US

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on smoke-free products with the power to deliver a smoke-free future.

With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and you will have the space to move your career forward in many different areas/directions.

We are hiring a seasoned and highly motivated Solution Architect to lead the architecture, governance guardrails, and secure adoption of the Microsoft 365 collaboration and content platform, with a strong focus on SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and productivity capabilities (OneDrive, Office apps, automation). The role will define and maintain platform guardrails (policies, standards and processes) in alignment with the corporate-wide standards for content management, data protection and identity/access policies.

You will be a key contributor in agile product teams, shaping the platform roadmap and ensuring solution designs are scalable, compliant, secure and usable—while also aligning the products with the organization’s AI strategy and enabling adoption, including Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness and agent integration across the enterprise.

This position blends deep technical expertise with the ability to communicate clearly at both technical detail and executive/business outcome levels.

JOIN US

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  

* Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3-5 years working with Microsoft 365; in depth understanding of content collaboration and productivity aspects of M365
* 2-4 years progressive experience in solution architecture
* Technical Skills: SharePoint Online architecture; Microsoft Teams collaboration architecture, solid understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and authorization patterns: group-based access, role-based administration concepts, identity governance including access reviews and lifecycle governance; Microsoft Graph and integration patterns; Power Platform (Power Automate), governance of connectors and automation
* Experience with enterprise-scale tenant governance, M&A collaboration onboarding, and complex stakeholder environments
* Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness and governance, including service boundary considerations and dependency on tenant permissions.
* Copilot Studio fundamentals: connectors/tools to integrate agents with business systems; publishing agents to SharePoint/Teams channels.
* Very good communication skills - ability to communicate with different audiences, both with deep technical articulation and high‑level executive abstraction
* Strong stakeholder management within technology teams and across business units and geographies
* Experience working in agile product models and with tools like Atlassian suite
* Comfortable in highly regulated, complex, global enterprise environments
* Nice to have: Experience with LeanIX; exposure to and understanding of TOGAF principles; experience and understanding of SAFe Agile framework, certification is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER YOU?

Important note: The benefits list depends on where the selected candidate will be hired: in Poland or in Portugal. We are open for both locations.

Benefits in Poland:

  

* Private medical and dental care, life insurance
* Hybrid model of work and flexible working arrangements (40% of office work and 60% of home office / month)
* Employee pension plan
* Lunch card, Multisport & Cafeteria program
* Wide range of trainings, language learning platform, further education and professional qualification support possibility
* Free bike and car parking for all employees

Benefits in Portugal:

  

* Permanent local contract with a competitive salary together with Tabaqueira’ s employee benefits
* Life and Health insurance
* Employee Pension Plan
* Hybrid working model (or fully remote)
* Growing opportunities within the Company, both at national and international level
* Very diverse and international work environment
* Wide range of trainings and further education and professional qualification support possibility

title: Solution Architect
description:
#### **About the role:**

As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise-grade solutions for audiology clinics and hearing care providers worldwide. This is a hands-on architecture role: you sit inside the Architecture Group, own system and integration design for your domains, and carry the same technical depth as everyone else in the group.

What makes it a solution role is the other half of the job. You will design the technical architecture - integrations, domain boundaries, system design - and you will shape the solution itself: working directly with Product, Sales, Delivery and customers to understand the clinical and commercial problem before deciding how to build for it. We are looking for someone equally comfortable in a customer workshop and in an architecture review; someone who treats "what should we build, and why" as part of their job, not someone else's.

Tech environment: .NET, React, Azure Cloud (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database), Azure DevOps.

#### **What You Will Do:**

**Solution Shaping & Business Partnership:**

* Act as the architectural counterpart to Product Management - translate business goals, market needs and customer workflows into solution options with clear trade-offs in cost, time, risk and long-term fit.
* Own end-to-end solution design for significant initiatives: not just the components, but how the whole thing delivers value to the customer's day-to-day operations.
* Challenge and refine requirements. Ask why before how and help the business distinguish the real problem from the requested feature.
* Present options and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders - commercial leadership, customer executives, clinical staff - in language they can act on.
* Build solution artefacts the business can use: solution overviews, capability maps, integration blueprints, effort and impact assessments.
* Partner with Delivery on sequencing and phasing so architecture supports a roadmap the business can actually commit to.
* Learn the audiology domain deeply enough to be a credible voice on clinical and operational workflows, not only on software.

**Customer & Pre-Sales Engagement:**

* Lead technical and solution workshops with customers and partners - discovery, requirements, integration approach, feasibility.
* Take an active role in pre-sales: technical scoping, solution proposals, RFP and tender responses, early-stage shaping and estimation - including enterprise and public-sector procurement processes with long sales cycles.
* Serve as trusted technical advisor to key accounts, including during escalations and complex distributed-system or integration troubleshooting.
* Feed customer and market insight back into platform strategy and the product roadmap.

**Domain & System Architecture:**

* Serve as technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high-level design, technology selection and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation and ADRs.

#### **What you bring:**

*Must-haves:*

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in architecture or solution-architecture roles within **enterprise SaaS**.
* Proven track record turning ambiguous business needs into implementable solution designs.
* Experience working alongside Product, Sales or Customer Success as the technical owner of a solution.
* Experience designing **integration architectures:** message-bus and event-streaming platforms, REST APIs, webhooks.
* Experience comparable **enterprise system** landscapes.
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event-driven architectures**.
* Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture.
* Solid understanding of **security and compliance** for regulated data (GDPR; HIPAA is a plus).
* Strong background in **Azure cloud services**.
* Proven ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and diagrams (C4 or similar).
* Strong **communication** skills: able to articulate architectural decisions to leadership, engineers and customers, and to adjust the level of abstraction to the audience.
* Confident and credible in **customer-facing** and **commercial** settings, including pre-sales.
* Fluent English proficiency.

*Nice-to-haves:*

* Experience designing or evolving multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience integrating with healthcare systems (EHR/EMR, HL7, FHIR)
* Exposure to healthcare, clinical or other regulated business domains; hospital or public-sector customers a plus.
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs or agent-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* .NET and React familiarity.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

*Key traits:*

* A business-minded engineer: you weigh architectural decisions against commercial and customer impact, not only technical elegance.
* An owner: you make the call, explain the reasoning, and follow the solution through to delivery and adoption.
* A bridge-builder across Engineering, Product, Delivery, Sales and the customer.
* Pragmatic about standards: ADRs, reviews and quality gates in service of what the business needs now.
* Curious - about technology, and about the customer's business and domain.

#### **What Success Looks Like (first 12 months):**

* 3 months: you know our products, domains and key customers, and you are the architectural counterpart to Product on one significant initiative.
* 6 months: you own the end-to-end solution design for that initiative - integration blueprint, phasing agreed with Delivery, and a solution the business has committed to.
* 12 months: customers and commercial leadership treat you as a trusted technical advisor, and your solution artefacts are how we scope complex deals.

#### **What's in it for you:**

* Long-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company
* Remote-first and async-friendly with flat organizational structure
* Real influence over both what we build and how we build it.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Direct exposure to customers and to the commercial side of the business.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA and more.

You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.  
*Please submit your English CV*

*Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

* Act as the architectural counterpart to Product Management - translate business goals, market needs and customer workflows into solution options with clear trade-offs in cost, time, risk and long-term fit.
* Own end-to-end solution design for significant initiatives: not just the components, but how the whole thing delivers value to the customer's day-to-day operations.
* Challenge and refine requirements. Ask why before how and help the business distinguish the real problem from the requested feature.
* Present options and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders - commercial leadership, customer executives, clinical staff - in language they can act on.
* Build solution artefacts the business can use: solution overviews, capability maps, integration blueprints, effort and impact assessments.
* Partner with Delivery on sequencing and phasing so architecture supports a roadmap the business can actually commit to.
* Learn the audiology domain deeply enough to be a credible voice on clinical and operational workflows, not only on software.

**Customer & Pre-Sales Engagement:**

* Lead technical and solution workshops with customers and partners - discovery, requirements, integration approach, feasibility.
* Take an active role in pre-sales: technical scoping, solution proposals, RFP and tender responses, early-stage shaping and estimation - including enterprise and public-sector procurement processes with long sales cycles.
* Serve as trusted technical advisor to key accounts, including during escalations and complex distributed-system or integration troubleshooting.
* Feed customer and market insight back into platform strategy and the product roadmap.

**Domain & System Architecture:**

* Serve as technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high-level design, technology selection and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation and ADRs.

#### **What you bring:**

*Must-haves:*

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in architecture or solution-architecture roles within **enterprise SaaS**.
* Proven track record turning ambiguous business needs into implementable solution designs.
* Experience working alongside Product, Sales or Customer Success as the technical owner of a solution.
* Experience designing **integration architectures:** message-bus and event-streaming platforms, REST APIs, webhooks.
* Experience comparable **enterprise system** landscapes.
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event-driven architectures**.
* Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture.
* Solid understanding of **security and compliance** for regulated data (GDPR; HIPAA is a plus).
* Strong background in **Azure cloud services**.
* Proven ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and diagrams (C4 or similar).
* Strong **communication** skills: able to articulate architectural decisions to leadership, engineers and customers, and to adjust the level of abstraction to the audience.
* Confident and credible in **customer-facing** and **commercial** settings, including pre-sales.
* Fluent English proficiency.

*Nice-to-haves:*

* Experience designing or evolving multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience integrating with healthcare systems (EHR/EMR, HL7, FHIR)
* Exposure to healthcare, clinical or other regulated business domains; hospital or public-sector customers a plus.
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs or agent-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* .NET and React familiarity.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

*Key traits:*

* A business-minded engineer: you weigh architectural decisions against commercial and customer impact, not only technical elegance.
* An owner: you make the call, explain the reasoning, and follow the solution through to delivery and adoption.
* A bridge-builder across Engineering, Product, Delivery, Sales and the customer.
* Pragmatic about standards: ADRs, reviews and quality gates in service of what the business needs now.
* Curious - about technology, and about the customer's business and domain.

#### **What Success Looks Like (first 12 months):**

* 3 months: you know our products, domains and key customers, and you are the architectural counterpart to Product on one significant initiative.
* 6 months: you own the end-to-end solution design for that initiative - integration blueprint, phasing agreed with Delivery, and a solution the business has committed to.
* 12 months: customers and commercial leadership treat you as a trusted technical advisor, and your solution artefacts are how we scope complex deals.

#### **What's in it for you:**

* Long-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company
* Remote-first and async-friendly with flat organizational structure
* Real influence over both what we build and how we build it.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Direct exposure to customers and to the commercial side of the business.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA and more.

You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.

title: Frontend Engineering Manager
description:
***Posting Type***

Hybrid

***Job Overview***

WHO WE ARE
  
Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.
  
The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.
  
  
WHAT WE DO
  
At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.
  
The Frontend Platform team enables engineering teams across Relativity to build consistent, accessible, scalable, and high-performing user experiences. The team is responsible for core UI infrastructure, frontend architecture, design systems, reusable component libraries, and frontend enablement capabilities that accelerate development velocity and maintain a high standard of user experience across products.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
We are looking for a Frontend Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing team responsible for building the core UI infrastructure, design systems, and frontend enablement capabilities that power modern web applications across Relativity.
  
As a hands-on technical leader, you will drive architectural decisions, foster engineering excellence, and empower your team to deliver accessible, performant, and scalable user interfaces. You will work cross-functionally with product, UX, and engineering leaders to define and deliver platform-wide solutions that enable development velocity and high-quality user experiences.
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical frontend expertise, people leadership, and a passion for building developer-focused platform capabilities in a stable, growth-oriented organization.

***Job Description and Requirements***

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required**

* 7+ years of frontend engineering experience, with 2-4 years in an engineering management or technical leadership role.
* Expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, with exposure to Angular or Vue.
* Deep knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, preprocessors (SASS/LESS), and responsive layout techniques.
* Experience architecting frontend platforms using component libraries, design systems, and Micro Frontend patterns.
* Strong understanding of state management solutions such as Redux, Recoil, or Zustand, and frontend performance optimization techniques including lazy loading and code splitting.
* Proficiency with frontend testing frameworks and strategies such as Jest, Cypress, and Playwright, including integration within CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs and asynchronous programming models.
* Track record of building accessible user interfaces that meet WCAG standards and internationalization requirements.
* Experience managing Agile teams with a focus on continuous delivery, feedback, and iteration.
* Strong collaboration, facilitation, and communication skills across cross-functional teams and leadership.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering enterprise SaaS products on Azure or another major cloud platform.
* Familiarity with backend technologies such as .NET, Node.js, or Python for effective coordination and API alignment.
* Exposure to containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes and cloud-native deployment practices.
* Hands-on experience with AI-driven UI solutions, including personalized interfaces, chatbots, or adaptive user experiences.
* Strong UX sensibility and the ability to bridge design intent with frontend implementation.
* Experience participating in design system governance or contributing to shared cross-team component architecture.

**WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT**

Impactful Mission

* Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

* Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

* Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

* Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

* Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

* Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation and Benefits

* Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

**Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.**

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

288 000 and 432 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

**Required Skills:**

Budget Management, Engineering Management, Innovation, Leadership, Performance Management (PM), Process Improvements, Project Management, Quality Assurance (QA), Risk Management, Stakeholder Management

### **5. Process & Continuous Improvement**

* Enforce engineering processes, standards, and tools
* Identify inefficiencies and lead process improvements
* Support adoption of scalable development practices

### **The Essentials - You Will Have:**

  + Electrical Engineering / Electronics
  + Computer Engineering / Embedded Systems

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Digital & Technology Team (D&T;) is an integral division of HEINEKEN Global Shared Services Center. We are committed to making Heineken the most connected brewery. That includes digitalizing and integrating our processes, ensuring best-in-class technology, and embedding a data-driven culture. By joining us you will work in one of the most dynamic and innovative teams and have a direct impact on building the future of Heineken!

Would you like to meet the Team, see our office and much more? Visit our website: Heineken (heineken-dt.pl)  
As the Senior Data Engineer in the Data Foundation scope, you have in-depth knowledge of the technical details and how the products work, and you will act as an expert in the team responsible for the technical configuration, development and integration of products and platforms based on our tech stack, used by specific business processes across OpCos, to better serve their customers.

You will provide expert guidance and ensure alignment with architecture and business objectives and ensure on-time delivery. You drive the end-to-end operations of the platforms, keeping them streamlined, structured, and within service level agreements. You will collaborate closely with other cross functional teams for efficient development pipelines. You will work directly with the Product Owner(s) and Product Architect(s), receiving pre-defined business requirements and translating them into technical specifications and services in line with overall engineering standards and roadmaps.

You will be expected to be implementing new features, deliver high quality code, follow the agile methodologies and be a team player. The most important part is to be part of the team effort towards value-driven outcomes and the successful completion of tasks. Your proactive approach will be key in maintaining comprehensive documentation and collaborating with your team members through offering help, raising question and actively taking part in all activities. You will serve as a key contributor in refining and driving excellence in engineering practices to deliver high-quality solutions throughout the software development lifecycle in our Data landscape.

The role reports directly to the Data Engineering Lead

Your responsibilities would include:

* coaching and mentoring individual Data Engineers in designing, developing, and delivering scalable, reliable, and high performing big data solutions
* coaching and mentoring the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and ETL processes. Monitor and optimize data infrastructure performance, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and issues
* coaching and mentoring the team from a technical standpoint, and drive operational excellence, including code reviews, design reviews, testing, and deployment processes
* being an individual contributor (~60%) engineering the software products/solutions, jointly with the team
* ensuring that the team adheres to coding standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines, oversee team spirit and team performance, guide and mentor team members
* overseeing the implementation of the technical architecture, solve immediate technical challenges
* ensuring that the execution of DevSecOps is in place in the team's daily work
* inspiring, advising and driving the selection of development approach
* cooridating software development and address technical debt in the team
* supporting onboarding, mentoring and developing top engineering talents, fostering a culture of learning,  
  collaboration, and continuous improvement
* taking Lead when needed in technical discussions with other teams/departments and oversees state-of-art quality of the stack
* may be involved in cross-functional discussions, representing the domain in broader technical discussions across domains
* being responsible for designing and improving processes that enhance efficiency and quality.
* communicating with Engineering Manager, Product Owner and Scrum Master to align on project / sprint goals, timeline and resource allocation.

You are a good candidate if you have: \* 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a strong understanding of data integration, ETL processes, and data warehousing. \* hands-on experience and in-depth knowledge of the technologies: \* proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, and experience with big data technologies like Massive Parallel Processing (MPP) and streaming. \* cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and compute/data storage solutions (e.g., Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake). \* CI/CD processes and tools, including Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and Git, to ensure smooth and efficient deployment of data solutions. \* APIs to push and pull data from data systems and Platforms \* understanding software architecture High level Design document and translating them to developmental tasks. \* Pyspark \* Microsoft data stack such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks and Fabric / PowerBI \* Apache Kafka or similar \* Data Modelling & Architecture \* ETL pipeline design \* strong understanding and implementation of software development principles, coding standards, and modern architecture \* familiarity with data governance and compliance standards \* hands-on experience in implementing and managing End-to-End DataOps / Data Engineering projects in a team \* proven ability to lead software development teams of engineers with varying experience and adapt to team sizes from small to large \* experience in working in diverse projects with varying technologies, products, and systems \* strong problem-solving skills and ability to make critical technical decisions \* ability to guide / mentor other team members \* effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. \* proven ability to demonstrate that can work independently and a self-starter \* pragmatic, and collaborative team player

Nice to have: \* Logging and Monitoring using Azure / Databricks services \* Experience with machine learning and AI technologies

title: QA Engineer
description:
SwingDev—a hippo company is the Polish branch of a **fast-growing InsurTech** product company – Hippo Insurance. We’re here to make home insurance smarter and more proactive, using tech to bring fresh solutions. We also create digital products that support our customers, always focusing on what really makes an impact.

Putting a lot of effort into hiring top-tier professionals is a proof that we care a lot about tech experience, the attitude, human approach, and what we could call „culture fit”.

**„SwingDev is all about people”** - yes, it may sound a bit cliche. But whether we're writing code or just hanging out, we know that people are at the heart of everything we do. We like to have a good time and keep things light, even when we're tackling big projects. We could brag about what’s making us special, but we’ve boiled it down to two key ingredients: mature, companionable people who, rather than compete, prefer to inspire and have each other’s backs; a culture of trust, empathy, and positivity that keeps us together, lets us interact as teammates and friends, and truly enjoy the ride.

So if you're a **QA Engineer** looking to shake things up and have a good time while you're at it, you’ve come to the right place.

### **What will you do?**

* You'll deeply collaborate with Engineering teams. This includes actively participating in the development of new features and initiatives, from initial requirement analysis and test planning to execution, regression testing, and final release sign-off.
* You'll partner closely with Product Managers. This means you will be responsible for prioritizing testing efforts, clarifying requirements, challenging assumptions from a quality perspective, coordinating Business Acceptance Testing, and advocating for the needs of our customers.
* You'll work closely with SDETs to expand and maintain our automated test coverage for new features and regression testing. You'll also collaborate with other manual QA engineers on cross-team and cross-BU projects.
* You'll proactively identify and mitigate potential risks, ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.

### **We might be a match if you…**

* Have 3+ years of QA experience, with a focus on manual testing (Black Box, White Box, and Grey Box).
* Have a good knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Have a good understanding of testing integration, functional, end-to-end, and API tests (Postman).
* Have experience with test case design, execution, and reporting for complex systems (front-end and back-end).
* Have an ability to create test cases and collections that exercise the requirements and business rules in colaboration with PMs.
* Worked with test case management tools (preferably XRay).
* Have good analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Are an independent problem solver but also a collaborative team player.
* Have a great command of English (written & spoken) and at least basic of Polish.
* Are available in the afternoons – we prioritize everyone’s personal time and work-life fit, but since we work in multinational teams, occasional evening meetings may be necessary to ensure smooth communication across time zones.

**You will get extra points for:**

* Experience working in a product company, ideally a startup/scale-up.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and their impact on the QA process.
* Experience with Jira and agile testing methodologies.
* Experience with Salesforce or any other CRM.

### **Recruitment process:**

* Send us your CV – it's the best way for us to get to know you.
* Meet with one of our Recruiters.
* Join for a Technical Interview.
* Have a conversation with your potential Engineering Manager.
* Meet on the final stage with Marcin and Alicja.
* and... welcome aboard!

**What benefits are waiting for you?**

**14 000 – 16 000 PLN + VAT on B2B** or equivalent on the contract of employment

Form of employment of your choosing

Remote work & flexible working hours

title: Manager, Engineering – Delivery Experience Backend Team
description:
**Location:**  
Warszawa, PL, 00-841
  
  
**Company:** Allegro sp. z o.o.
  
**Team:** Technology
  
**Contract Type:** Employee
  
  
**About the job:**  
Are you excited about making a big impact in the e-commerce logistics sector? Allegro's Delivery Experience area is searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager to lead our backend team. You will be leading an existing team of 4 people, including backend engineers and testers. Here's why you should join us:
  
  
**Strategic Transformation:** Lead the evolution of a critical integration platform, including the migration of selected services from .NET/Azure to Allegro’s strategic JVM and GCP stack.
  
  
**High-Impact Domain:** Work at the core of our logistics and integration ecosystem. Your team's services are the foundational layer for our carrier platform strategy, significantly reducing cross-team dependencies and drastically cutting down carrier onboarding time.
  
  
**Innovative Integrations:** Manage and develop key APIs for our delivery network, enabling external partners to seamlessly integrate with our infrastructure (such as our parcel lockers). You will also oversee hybrid integrations that connect multiple carriers, shaping the future of our delivery ecosystem.
  
  
**Business & Tech Synergy:** Play a crucial role in bridging the gap between business and technology. You will translate complex business expectations into technical solutions and confidently represent Allegro in technical discussions with external partners.
  
  
**Important things for you:**  
Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
  
  
Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:
  
  
Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
  
  
Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
  
  
Our team is based in Warsaw.
  
  
**In your daily work, you will handle the following tasks:**  
Planning and executing the strategic migration of microservices from .NET to JVM/Kotlin/GCP without disrupting ongoing operations.
  
  
Managing, mentoring, and supporting a focused backend engineering team, guiding them smoothly through a major technology stack transition.
  
  
Maintaining existing integration APIs and developing new features to support incoming carriers and new business requests.
  
  
Acting as a translator between business stakeholders and the engineering team, ensuring technical deliverables align with business expectations.
  
  
Leading technical discussions and negotiations with business partners.
  
  
Supporting the team in daily operations, including participating in on-call duties and providing hands-on technical guidance.
  
  
**We are looking for people who:**  
Have a strong technical background in backend development (.NET or Java) and are enthusiastic about leading a technology transformation towards the JVM ecosystem.
  
  
Have experience in planning, managing, and executing complex system migrations or architectural overhauls.
  
  
Possess strong business acumen and can comfortably translate high-level business needs into actionable technical tasks.
  
  
Are excellent communicators, confident in representing the team externally and acting as a trusted partner in technical discussions.
  
  
Are willing to be hands-on when necessary.
  
  
Have a product-oriented mindset with proven experience in maintaining and scaling critical APIs.
  
  
Are fluent in both Polish and English (B2 level).
  
  
**What’s in it for you:**  
Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
  
  
A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
  
  
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
  
  
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
  
  
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
  
  
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
  
  
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.
  
  
And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.
  
  
**#goodtobehere means that:**  
You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
  
  
You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
  
  
You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
  
  
You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
  
  
You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
  
  
You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
  
  
You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!
  
  
Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!
  
  
Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online!
  
  
Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

title: Cloud Solution Architect - Infrastructure & AI
description:

We’re looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to help customers migrate, modernize and secure their infrastructure, applications, and data on Microsoft Azure, laying the foundation for scalable, production-ready AI solutions. As part of the Cloud + AI Infrastructure team, you’ll deliver engagements focused on migration, modernization, operational excellence and resilient architecture using frameworks like Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework (WAF).

You’ll leverage existing Repeatable IP and execution engines for critical milestones, ensure infrastructure, application, and database readiness for AI workloads, and ensure successful deployment that accelerates adoption. You’ll work closely with customer IT leaders to design and implement scalable solutions, resolve blockers, and accelerate adoption of Azure services through repeatable IP and delivery excellence. With deep expertise across Azure infrastructure, applications, databases, SAP, and hybrid environments, you’ll play a key role in helping customers unlock the full value of their Microsoft Azure investments.  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Build trusted relationships with key customer IT decision makers to drive long-term cloud adoption and serve as the Voice of the Customer—sharing insights and removing blockers through collaboration with Microsoft engineering teams.
* Lead architectural design sessions and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions aligned to customer business goals using frameworks like CAF and WAF.
* Own the end-to-end technical delivery results, ensuring completeness and accuracy of consumption and customer success plans in collaboration with the CSAM.
* Drive migration and modernization initiatives, including committed proof of concept and production milestones, across infrastructure, data, SAP, and AI workloads.
* Ensure customer environments are optimized for health, resiliency, security, and performance—enabling production-scale AI use cases.
* Deliver repeatable IP and contribute to centralized IP development to accelerate deployment and achieve targeted outcomes.
* Identify and resolve technical blockers to accelerate go-live and ensure delivery excellence across key Factory engagements.
* Generate incremental pipeline from each engagement by driving next best actions and aligning with Unified Enterprise Support (ES) priorities.
* Maintain technical intensity through continuous skilling and certifications in priority workloads such as Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, AKS, App Service, AVS, SAP (Native + RISE), Windows, Linux and Defender for Cloud.
* Engage in technical communities, share best practices, and contribute to knowledge reuse to accelerate customer transformation and success.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Infra Domain (all genders)
description:
**About us**

**Distribusion** is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.  
  
**The opportunity**

As the **Engineering Manager** for the Infrastructure domain, you will lead the teams responsible for the foundations that power Distribusion's products and operations. Covering Platform Engineering, IT, and Information Security, your mission is to build scalable, secure, and reliable systems that enable our engineering teams and the wider business to operate at their best.

To prepare our technical foundation for 10x growth, we are looking for a highly strategic, business-oriented leader to transform how these critical functions operate. You will act as the crucial bridge between our infrastructure and the broader company by professionalising our tech stack, driving complex vendor negotiations, and building transparent roadmaps that clearly showcase your team's impact.

**What you will do**

* You'll lead the teams that keep Distribusion running securely, reliably, and at scale.
* From cloud infrastructure and developer tooling to internal IT and information security, you'll be responsible for the platforms and processes that enable our teams to move fast with confidence.
* You'll grow and support a team spanning Platform Engineering, IT, and Security, helping define strategy, drive execution, and raise the bar for operational excellence across the company.
* Vendor management including negotiating conditions and overseeing detailed infrastructure and project cost tracking.
* Your work will directly impact the productivity of our engineers, the resilience of our systems, and the security of our business as we continue to scale globally.

**Workplace:** Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role to be based in Germany, preferably in our headquarters in Berlin.

**Who you are**

* 5+ years of experience leading and developing engineering teams in high-growth technology environments.
* Strong technical background in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, Information Security, or related domains.
* Proven track record of building, scaling, and improving engineering teams, processes, and operational excellence.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational priorities.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud-native architectures, infrastructure automation, observability, and security best practices.
* Experience driving reliability, availability, and security improvements in production environments at scale.
* Ability to partner effectively with Engineering, Product, and Business stakeholders and align technical initiatives with company goals.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions across all levels of the organisation.
* Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers and technical leaders.
* Data-driven mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Fluent in English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading teams across Platform Engineering, Internal IT, and Information Security functions.
* Experience with compliance and security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or GDPR-related initiatives.
* Experience supporting globally distributed engineering organisations.
* Previous experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS, marketplace, or travel technology company.

**What you can expect**

* **Make a global impact.** Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.
* **Own your work.** Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.
* **Built with the best tools.** We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.
* **Work with industry leaders.** Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
* **Grow with exceptional people.** Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.
* **Work your way.** Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

***Our hiring team for this role:***

*Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is* ***Lorena Rebenciuc****, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is* ***Ilya Isakov****.*

*For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at (*talent@distribusion.com*).*

*Do you want to work on a product used by millions of people daily, with high load, availability, and scalability, and the most advanced technology?* Come join us!

title: Engineering Manager, Search Engine (all genders)
description:
**About us**

**Distribusion** is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.  
  
**The opportunity**

We are looking for an **Engineering Manager** to lead our Search team. The role entails contributing to the product & technical domains of excellence in the main API product that enables large retailers to seamlessly purchase tickets from bus & rail carriers worldwide.

This is a highly skilled, senior engineering team operating in a highly complex, high-throughput, and low-latency domain.

You will be stepping into an area where performance and cost-efficiency are critical, and your biggest challenge will be technical and strategic. With our platform scaling rapidly, your mission is to prepare our architecture for 10x growth. We need a hands-on leader who still fundamentally thinks of themselves as an Engineer, capable of diving deep into the technical weeds while steering the domain's business goals.

**What you will do:**

* Manage, lead, and support an experienced team of engineers, providing coaching, alignment, and performance management.
* Take ownership of domain health, ensuring our high-throughput, low-latency systems are robust, scalable, and consistently meeting performance goals.
* Drive profitability and cost optimisation, specifically tackling architectural challenges to scale our system 10x without allowing our current infrastructure and storage costs to multiply exponentially.
* Act as a hands-on technical leader, staying close to the code, system design, and architecture in a highly complex problem space.

**Workplace:** Berlin & hybrid / EU & Remote

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe. Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets.

**Who you are:**

* You are an experienced people leader who has successfully managed and supported senior engineering teams.
* You think of yourself as an Engineer at heart; you are highly technical, hands-on, and capable of understanding and guiding deeply complex system architectures.
* You have a proven track record building, maintaining, and scaling high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
